fields.title: Ekigendererwa mu Kusaba
fields.subtitle: Ku Kulemerako n’Okusaba Okutaggwaamu Maanyi
fields.description: Essuula kkumi n’essatu ezitaliiko mitwe, buli emu ng’etandika n’ebigambo by’omusajja eyasabanga — Gilmour ow’e Mongolia, Brother Lawrence, Fletcher ow’e Madeley — oluvannyuma Bounds n’anyigiriza ensonga emu: nti okusaba mulimu, era nti okuwulira nti omusajja ali mu kusaba tali na ky’akola bwe bulimba obukaliza ekisenge eky’okusabiramu. Awoza okuva mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu bulamu bw’abasajja abaasabanga ebbanga eddene, ku lw’okusaba okweyongera okusaba. Kye kitabo kye ekisinga okubaamu ebigambo ebijuliziddwa, era ekisinga obutaba na ntegeka.

qa.question: Ekitabo Ekigendererwa mu Kusaba kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Y’ensonga ya E. M. Bounds nti okusaba mulimu — omulimu ogw’okugenderera era ogulina ekigendererwa, so si mbeera ya kutuula butuuzi. Mu ssuula kkumi n’essatu, buli emu ng’etandika n’ebigambo by’omusajja eyasabanga nga Gilmour ow’e Mongolia, Brother Lawrence, oba Fletcher ow’e Madeley, Bounds anyigiriza ensonga emu: nti okuwulira nti omusajja ali mu kusaba tali na ky’akola bulimba, era nti okwegayiririra abalala kiri mu mirimu egisinga obuzibu n’obukulu Omukristaayo gy’ayinza okukola.

qa.question: Ensonga enkulu ey’ekitabo y’eruwa?
qa.answer: Nti okusaba kulina okugobererwa n’ekigendererwa — n’okugenderera, okumalirira, n’okwefuba — mu kifo ky’okulekebwa ku mukisa oba ku nneewulira. Bounds awoza nti okusaba okukulu, ng’omulimu omukulu, kwa kugenderera; kuteekerwateekerwa, kuweebwa obudde, era kunyigirizibwa n’okwagala kwonna. Abakristaayo abatuukiriza bingi mu kusaba be abo abeewaayo gye kuli mu bugenderevu, so si abo abasaba nga bakwatiddwako bwokka.

qa.question: Lwaki Bounds anyweza nti okusaba mulimu?
qa.answer: Kubanga ayagala okusuula endowooza nti omuntu ali mu kusaba atudde butuuzi. Okusaba, bw’awoza, mulimu gwa ddala — ogwetaagisa amaanyi, ogw’omuwendo, era ogukola — okutegana okukwekeddwa okuli emabega w’obuweereza bwonna obw’Ekikristaayo obubala ebibala. Okukutwala ng’okwangu oba okw’okwesalirawo kwe kukutegeera obubi; Bounds akuteeka mu bintu ebisinga okwetaagisa amaanyi n’okuba n’ebiva mu byo omukkiriza by’akola.

qa.question: Lwaki buli ssuula etandika n’omusajja eyasabanga?
qa.answer: Kubanga Bounds ayigiriza n’ebyokulabirako nga bw’ayigiriza n’ensonga. Bw’asooka buli ssuula n’ebigambo oba obujulirwa bw’omusajja amanyiddwa mu kusaba — omuminsani, omuntu eyeewaayo mu bulamu obw’omunda, omutukuvu — asimba ensonga ye mu bulamu obwagikakasa, ng’alaga nti abo abaakolera Katonda ebisinga be baali beewaayo eri okusaba okulina ekigendererwa.

qa.question: Ekitabo kyogera ki ku kulemerako?
qa.answer: Nti okusaba okulina ekigendererwa kwe kusaba okugumiikiriza — nti ekigendererwa ekikkalidde kikuuma omukkiriza ng’asaba ng’ayita mu kulwawo, mu bukalu, ne mu kuggwaamu amaanyi okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kujja. Bounds asiba ekigendererwa ku kulemerako: oyo eyamalirira okusaba tava ku nsonga mangu, wabula yeeyongera mu maaso n’okugenderera, era okusaba okw’engeri eyo okutakyuka era okw’okugenderera kwe kuwangula.

qa.question: E. M. Bounds yali ani?
qa.answer: Yali musumba Omumetodisti Omumerika eyagolokokanga obudde nga tebunnakya okusaba era eyawaayo ekkalaamu ye eri ensonga eno obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo. Ebitabo bye ku kusaba, ebisinga byafulumizibwa ng’amaze okufa, biri mu bisinga okuba n’obuyinza ebyali biwandiikiddwa ku kwegayiririra abalala, era Ekigendererwa mu Kusaba kwe kukoowoola kwe okutasalako okutwala okusaba ng’omulimu ogw’amaanyi era ogw’okugenderera.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kya ani?
qa.answer: Kya Mukristaayo obulamu bwe obw’okusaba obuba obw’akaseera n’akaseera era obutateekerwateekerwa, era ateebereza nti tewali kinene kibuvaamu. Bounds awandiika okuyita omusomi ng’oyo eri ekigendererwa — okufuula okusaba ekigendererwa ekikkalidde mu kifo ky’okukwatibwako okw’oluusi n’oluusi — n’okumukakasa nti omulimu guno ogukwekeddwa gusaana okumalirira kwe kwonna.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanye kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, ng’ayita mu ssuula mu nteeko yaazo, ng’aleka abajulirwa abatandika buli emu okunyweza ensonga. Kimpi era kizzaamu amaanyi, ekitabo kigendereddwamu okuggya omusomi mu kugenderera okutali kunywevu okumutuusa ku kigendererwa ekikkalidde, kale kisinga okusomebwa ng’okuyita okukola — n’oluvannyuma okukolerwako mu bulamu bw’okusaba obw’okugenderera.

fields.title: Katonda Abumba Ensi olw’Okusaba
fields.body_html:
Enzikiriza yange endeetera okulowooza nti okusaba kulina amaanyi okutuukiriza ekisabibwa, era mazima olunaku lw’omuntu lw’amala ng’asaba Katonda okufuga byonna ebigwawo bibe birungi terufa bwereere. Naye wakyaliwo endowooza ey’amaanyi nti omuntu bw’aba ng’asaba aba takola kintu, era endowooza eno etuleetera okuwa omulimu ekitiibwa ekisukkiridde, oluusi n’okwanguyiriza okusaba oba n’okukulagajjalira ddala.

Mu mulembe gwaffe tetwesigama nnyo ku mukono gw’omubiri? Ebyamagero bye bimu tebiyinza kukolebwa leero nga bwe byakolebwanga edda? Amaaso ga Mukama tegakyalaba wonna mu nsi, okweraga nga wa maanyi ku lw’abo abamwesiga? Woowe, Katonda ampe okukkiriza okusingawo, okw’omu bulamu obwa bulijjo, mu ye! Kaakano Mukama, Katonda wa Eriya ali luuyi wa? Alindirira Eriya amukoowoole.—James Gilmour ow’e Mongolia

Gye kikoma okubaawo okusaba okungi mu nsi, ensi gy’ekoma okuba ennungi, n’amaanyi agalwanyisa ekibi buli wamu gye gakoma okweyongera. Okusaba, mu ngeri emu gye kukolamu, kuli ng’eddagala erisaanyaawo obuwuka era eriziyiza endwadde. Kulongoosa empewo; kuzikiriza obulwadde bw’ekibi obusiigibwa. Okusaba si kintu kya kaseera buseera ekiggwaawo amangu. Si ddoboozi erikaabira mu kasirise ne litawulirwa era ne litafiibwako. Ddoboozi eriyingira mu kutu kwa Katonda, era liwangaala ebbanga lyonna okutu kwa Katonda nga kukyali kuggule eri okwegayirira okutukuvu, ebbanga lyonna omutima gwa Katonda nga gukyafaayo ku bintu ebitukuvu.

Katonda abumba ensi ng’ayita mu kusaba. Okusaba tekufa. Emimwa egyakwogera giyinza okuba nga gyasirikira mu kufa, omutima ogwakuwulira guyinza okuba nga gwalekera awo okukuba, naye okusaba kuba kulamu mu maaso ga Katonda, era omutima gwa Katonda gukussaako, era okusaba kuwangaala okusinga obulamu bw’abo abakwogera; kuwangaala okusinga omulembe gumu, okusinga ekiseera kyonna, okusinga ensi yonna.

Omuntu oyo y’asinga obutafa, eyakola okusaba okungi era okusinga obulungi. Abo be bazira ba Katonda, abatukuvu ba Katonda, abaweereza ba Katonda, ababaka abamukiikirira. Omuntu asobola okusaba obulungi okusingawo olw’okusaba kw’ab’edda; omuntu asobola okubeera omulamu mu butukuvu obusingawo olw’okusaba kw’ab’edda; omuntu ow’okusaba okungi era okukkirizibwa y’akoledde omulembe oguddako omulimu ogusinga obwesigwa n’obukulu. Okusaba kw’abatukuvu ba Katonda kunyweza omulembe ogutannazaalibwa okulwanyisa amayengo ag’ekibi n’obubi agazikiriza. Zisanze omulembe gw’abaana abasanga ebyoterezo byabwe nga tebiriimu bubaane bwa muwendo obw’okusaba; abo bakitaabwe be baali n’emirimu emingi ennyo oba abataalina kukkiriza kumala okusaba, era akabi akatayogerekeka n’ebivaamu ebitabalika bye busika bwabwe obw’ennaku. Balina omukisa abo bakitaabwe ne bannyaabwe be baalekera obusika obungi obw’okusaba.

Okusaba kw’abatukuvu ba Katonda bwe bugagga obw’entandikwa mu ggulu, Kristo bw’akozesa okutambuza omulimu gwe omunene ku nsi. Okukankana okunene n’okusika okw’amaanyi ku nsi bye bivudde mu kusaba kuno. Ensi ekyuka, ekyusibwa ddala, bamalayika batambula n’ebiwaawaatiro eby’amaanyi n’eby’embiro okusingawo, era enteekateeka ya Katonda ebumbibwa ng’okusaba bwe kweyongera obungi n’okukola obulungi.

Kya mazima nti obuwanguzi obusingayo obunene obujja ku mulimu gwa Katonda butondebwa era butambuzibwa okusaba. Olunaku lwa Katonda olw’amaanyi; ennaku za bamalayika ez’okukola n’amaanyi, ze nnaku Ekkanisa ya Katonda mw’etuukira ku busika bwayo obusingirayo ddala obw’okukkiriza okusingayo n’okusaba okusingayo. Ennaku za Katonda ez’okuwangula ze nnaku abatukuvu mwe beewaddeyo eri okusaba okusingayo amaanyi. Ennyumba ya Katonda ku nsi bw’eba ennyumba ey’okusabiramu, olwo ennyumba ya Katonda mu ggulu eba ekola nnyo era nga ya buyinza bwonna mu nteekateeka zaayo n’entambula zaayo, olwo amaggye ge ag’oku nsi ne gambazibwa obuwanguzi n’omunyago gw’obuwanguzi, n’abalabe be ne bawangulwa buli ludda.

Katonda asimbye obulamu n’okukulaakulana kw’omulimu gwe ku kusaba. Obukwakkulizo buno bwateekebwa mu kubeerawo kwennyini okw’omulimu gwa Katonda mu nsi eno. Nsaba bwe bukwakkulizo bwokka Katonda bw’ateeka ku kukulaakulana n’obuwanguzi bw’omulimu gwe.

Abantu basaanidde okusaba—okusabira omulimu gwa Katonda gukulaakulane. Okusaba kuleeta Katonda mu nsi n’amaanyi ge gonna. Eri omuntu asaba, Katonda abeerawo n’amaanyi ageeyolese; eri Ekkanisa esaba, Katonda abeerawo mu buyinza obw’ekitiibwa, era Zabbuli ey’Okubiri y’ennyonnyola ya Katonda ey’okunywezebwa kw’omulimu gwa Katonda okuyita mu Yesu Kristo. Enteekateeka zonna ez’edda ezaali wansi zaggweera mu kutuuzibwa kwa Yesu Kristo ku ntebe. Katonda alangirira okutuuzibwa kw’Omwana we ku ntebe. Amawanga gasunguwalidde omulimu gwe n’obukyayi obukambwe. Katonda ayogerwako ng’asekerera obukyayi bwabwe obunafuye. Mukama aseka; Mukama abasekerera busekerezi. “Ddala ddala nateekawo kabaka owange ku lusozi lwange Sayuuni olutukuvu.” Ekiragiro kyayise, tekikyuka era kya lubeerera:

Nzija kulangirira ekiragiro kya Mukama:

kubanga yaŋŋamba nti, Ggwe oli Mwana wange,

olwa leero nfuuse kitaawo.

Nsaba, nange ndikuwa amawanga gonna okuba obusika bwo,

era n’ensi yonna gy’ekoma okuba amatwale go.

Olibafugisa omuggo ogw’ekyuma,

era olibabetenta ng’entamu y’omubumbi.

Nsaba bwe bukwakkulizo eri abantu abasaba, abeetegefu era abawulize. “Abantu bamwegayiririrenga era bamusabirenga emikisa buli lunaku.” Wansi w’ekisuubizo kino ekya bonna era ekyangu, abasajja n’abakazi ab’edda beewaayo eri Katonda. Baasaba, Katonda n’addamu okusaba kwabwe, era omulimu gwa Katonda ne gukuumibwa nga mulamu mu nsi olw’omuliro gw’okusaba kwabwe.

Okusaba kwafuuka obukwakkulizo obunywevu era obw’omu bwokka obutambuza Obwakabaka bw’Omwana we. “Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo.” Asinga amaanyi mu bwakabaka bwa Kristo y’oyo asinga okumanya okukonkona. Ekyama ky’okuwangula mu Bwakabaka bwa Kristo kwe kusobola okusaba. Oyo asobola okukozesa amaanyi g’okusaba y’oyo ow’amaanyi, omutukuvu mu Bwakabaka bwa Kristo. Essomo erisinga obukulu lye tuyinza okuyiga kwe kumanya okusaba.

Okusaba kye kisinga obukulu mu bulamu obusinga okutukuzibwa, ne mu buweereza obusinga obutukuvu. Akola ennyo ku lwa Katonda y’oyo asinga obukugu mu kusaba. Yesu Kristo yakola obuweereza bwe mu ngeri eno.

fields.title: Okusaba Kukyusa Ekigendererwa kya Katonda
fields.body_html:
Nti tusaanidde okwewaayo eri Katonda mu bintu eby’omubiri n’eby’omwoyo, era tunoonye essanyu lyaffe mu kutuukiriza okwagala kwe kwokka, ka atukulembere mu kubonaabona oba mu kubudaabudibwa, kubanga byonna byandibadde bye bimu eri Emmeeme eyeewaddeyo ddala. Okusaba si kirala wabula okuwulira okubeerawo kwa Katonda.—Ow’oluganda Lawrence

Kakasa nti ofaayo ku buvunaanyizibwa bwo obw’ekyama; bukuume ka obe ng’okola ki. Emmeeme teyinza kukulaakulana ng’ebulagajjalidde. Okuva mu kukkiriza kutera kutandikira ku mulyango gw’ekisenge eky’okusabiramu. Beeranga nnyo mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda mu kyama. Okusuubula okw’ekyama kwe kugaggawaza Omukristaayo.

Saba wekka. Okusaba kubeere ekisumuluzo eky’okumakya n’ekisiba eky’ekiro. Engeri esinga obulungi ey’okulwanyisa ekibi kwe kukirwanyisa nga tufukamidde.—Philip Henry

Okusaba okw’okukkiriza ge maanyi gokka mu bitonde byonna Yakuwa Omukulu g’agondera. Okusaba lye ddagala erisinga byonna.—Robert Hall

Essaawa emu ey’okubeera wekka ng’ogimala mu kusaba okw’amazima n’okw’omutima ogunyiikivu, oba okulwanagana n’okuwangula okwegomba okumu oba ekibi ekimu ekikwekeddwa mu kifuba, bijja kutuyigiriza bingi ku kulowooza, bijja kuzuukusa amaanyi g’okulowooza n’okuzimba empisa y’okufumiitiriza okusinga omwaka gumu ogw’okusoma mu masomero nga tebirina.—Coleridge

Omuntu ayinza okusaba emisana n’ekiro ne yeerimba, naye tewali muntu ayinza kukakasa bwesimbu bwe nga tasaba. Okusaba kwe kukkiriza nga kufuuka ekikolwa. Kwe kugatta okwagala n’amagezi nga bituukirira mu kikolwa eky’amagezi. Omuntu yenna mulamba y’asaba. Ekiri wansi w’ekyo kwe kwegomba obwegombi oba omulimu gw’emimwa, kwefuula oba mukolo gwa bwereere.

Katonda bw’anaanzizaawo obulamu bwange, mmaliridde obutasoma kirala kyonna wabula Bayibuli. Ebitabo eby’amagezi g’ensi bya bulabe eri obulamu bw’omwoyo bwe bitafugibwa na mukono munywevu.—Richard Cecil

Okutukuzibwa kwaffe tekwesigama ku kukyusa mirimu gyaffe, wabula ku kukola ku lwa Katonda ebyo bye tutera okukola ku lwaffe. Ekiseera kyange eky’emirimu tekyawukana ku kiseera eky’okusaba. Okusaba si kirala wabula okuwulira okubeerawo kwa Katonda.—Ow’oluganda Lawrence

Ka nzigweerewo ku lwa Katonda. Ku nkomerero, ka Katonda alagire ki, okusaba kye kintu ekikulu. Woowe, ka mbeere omuntu ow’okusaba.—Henry Martyn

Ebisoboka n’obwetaavu bw’okusaba, amaanyi gaakwo n’ebivaamu, birabikira mu kuyimiriza n’okukyusa ebigendererwa bya Katonda, ne mu kuwonya ekibonerezo eky’obuyinza bwe. Abimereki yakubibwa Katonda:

Awo Ibulayimu n’asabira Abimereki eri Katonda, ne Katonda n’awonya Abimereki era n’awonya ne mukazi we; n’abaweereza be abakazi ne balyoka bazaala abaana.

Kubanga Mukama yali aggalidde embuto z’ab’omu nnyumba y’Abimereki olwa Saala mukazi wa Ibulayimu.

Abasaasizi ba Yobu ab’ennaku era abaali bakyamu baali beeyisizza bwe batyo mu kukaayana kwabwe ne Yobu, obusungu bwa Katonda ne bubabuubuukirako. “Omuddu wange Yobu ajja kubasabira,” Katonda bwe yagamba, “kubanga nzija kukkiriza okusaba kwe.”

“Awo Mukama n’aggyawo ennaku ya Yobu bwe yamala okusabira mikwano gye.”

Yona yali mu mbeera embi ennyo “Mukama n’aleeta omuyaga ogw’amaanyi ne gukunta ku nnyanja.” Bwe baakuba obululu, “akalulu ne kagwa ku Yona.” Yasuulibwa mu nnyanja, naye “Mukama yateekateeka ekyennyanja ekinene ennyo ne kimira Yona ... Awo Yona n’asinziira mu kyennyanja n’asaba Mukama Katonda we ... Awo Mukama Katonda n’alagira ekyennyanja ne kiwandula Yona n’agwa ettale ku lukalu.”

Nnabbi eyali ajeemye bwe yayimusa eddoboozi lye mu kusaba, Katonda yawulira n’amuweereza okununulibwa.

Falaawo yali akkiririza ddala mu bisoboka by’okusaba, ne mu busobozi bwakwo okuwonya. Bwe yali ng’atagala wansi w’ebikolimo bya Katonda eby’entiisa, yeegayirira Musa amwegayiririre. “Mwegayirire Mukama,” kwe kwali okwegayirira kwe okw’ennaku, kwe yaddiŋŋana emirundi ena ng’ebibonyoobonyo bikuba Misiri. Emirundi ena okwegayirira kuno okw’amaanyi kwaleetebwa eri Musa, era emirundi ena okusaba kwaggyawo ekikolimo eky’entiisa ku kabaka omukakanyavu n’ensi ye eyali egenda okuzikirira.

Okuvvoola n’okusinza ebifaananyi kwa Isirayiri mu kukola ennyana eya zaabu ne bagyewaayo, kwali kusobya kwa ntiisa. Obusungu bwa Katonda bwabuubuuka, n’alangirira nti agenda kuzikiriza abantu abo abaali basobezza. Mukama yali asunguwalidde nnyo ne Alooni, era n’agamba Musa nti, “Leka mbazikirize—Naye Musa n’asaba, ne yeeyongera okusaba; emisana n’ekiro yasaba ennaku amakumi ana. Yeewandiikira yekka ebyo eby’okulwana kwe mu kusaba. “Ate ne nziramu okweyala wansi,” bw’agamba, “awali Mukama Katonda okumala ennaku amakumi ana, emisana n’ekiro; ne sirya ku mmere wadde okunywa ku tuzzi okumala ennaku amakumi ana emisana n’ekiro, olw’ekibi kye mwali mukoze, bwe mwakola ebitasaana mu maaso ga Mukama Katonda ne mumusunguwaza. Ne ntya nnyo olw’obusungu bwa Mukama Katonda n’ekiruyi kye, kubanga yali abasunguwalidde nnyo ng’ayinza n’okubazikiriza. Naye era Mukama n’ampuliriza ne ku mulundi ogwo. Era Mukama yali asunguwalidde nnyo Alooni nga n’okumuzikiriza ayinza okumuzikiriza. Naye mu kiseera ekyo ne Alooni ne mmusabira nnyo.”

“Bwe waliyitawo ennaku amakumi ana, Nineeve kirizikirira. Kyali kigendererwa kya Katonda okuzikiriza ekibuga ekyo ekinene era ekibi. Naye Nineeve kyasaba, nga kibikkiddwa ebibukutu; nga kitudde mu vvu kyakaabirira “nnyo Katonda,” era Katonda “n’abasonyiwa n’atabatuusaako kibonerezo, kye yali agambye okubatuusaako.”

Obubaka bwa Katonda eri Keezeekiya bwali nti: “Teekateeka ennyumba yo, kubanga togenda kulama, ogenda kufa.” Awo Keezeekiya n’akyuka n’atunuulira ekisenge n’asaba ne yeegayirira Mukama, n’agamba nti: “Jjukira kaakano, Ayi Mukama, nkwegayiridde, engeri gye natambuliranga mu maaso go n’amazima n’omutima ogutuukiridde, ne nkola ebisaanidde mu maaso go.” Era Keezeekiya n’akaaba nnyo amaziga. Katonda n’agamba Isaaya nti, “Genda ogambe Keezeekiya nti, Mpulidde okusaba kwo, ndabye amaziga go: laba nzija kwongera ku nnaku zo emyaka kkumi n’ettaano.”

Abantu bano baali bamanyi okusaba n’okuwangula mu kusaba. Okukkiriza kwabwe mu kusaba tekwali ndowooza ya kaseera ekyuka n’empewo oba n’enneewulira zaabwe n’embeera zaabwe; kyali kintu kya mazima nti Katonda awulira era addamu, nti okutu kwe kwali kuggule bulijjo eri okukaaba kw’abaana be, era nti amaanyi ge ag’okukola ekyo ekimusabibwa gaali genkana n’okwagala kwe. Era bwe batyo abantu bano, ab’amaanyi mu kukkiriza ne mu kusaba, be bo “abaawangula bakabaka, be baakola eby’obutuukirivu, be baafuna ebyasuubizibwa, era be baabuniza obumwa bw’empologoma, be baazikiza omuliro ogw’amaanyi, be baawona obwogi bw’ekitala. Be baaweebwa amaanyi okuva mu bunafu, era be baafuuka abazira ab’amaanyi mu ntalo, ne bagoba amaggye g’amawanga.”

Byonna olwo, nga bwe kiri kaakano, byali bisoboka eri abasajja n’abakazi abaali bamanyi okusaba. Mazima okusaba kwaggulawo etterekero eritaliiko kkomo, era omukono gwa Katonda tegwagaana kintu. Okusaba kwayingiza abo abaakukolanga mu nsi ey’enkizo, ne kuleeta amaanyi n’obugagga bw’eggulu wansi okuyamba omuntu ow’ekkomo. Nga gaali maanyi ga ttendo era ga kitalo ag’abo abaali bayize ekyama ky’okusemberera Katonda mu buwanguzi! Ku Musa kwalokola eggwanga; ku Ezera kwalokola ekkanisa.

Era naye, newankubadde kyewuunyisa bwe tulowooza ku byamagero abantu ba Katonda bye baali balabye, waajjawo obunafu mu kusaba. Okukwata Katonda okw’amaanyi, okwali kutera okuleeta okutya n’entiisa mu mitima gy’abalabe baabwe, kwasumulukuka. Abantu, nga baddiridde era nga bavudde mu kukkiriza, baali balekedde awo okusaba kwabwe—bwe kiba nti abasinga obungi mu bo baali basabye ddala mu mazima. Okusaba okunnyogovu era okutaliimu bulamu okw’Omufalisaayo kwadda mu kifo ky’okusemberera Katonda kwonna okw’amazima, era olw’engeri eyo ey’okusaba ey’omukolo obukolo, okusinza kwonna ne kufuuka kifaananyi kya bwereere eky’ekigendererwa kyakwo ekyennyini. Yali nteekateeka ya kitiibwa, era yatuukirizibwa mu kitiibwa, Musa, Ezera, Danyeri ne Eriya, Kaana ne Samwiri; naye olukuŋŋaana lwabwe lulabika nga lwali lutono era lwa kaseera buseera; abaasabanga baali batono nnyo era nga basaasaanidde. Tebaalina basigalira, tebaalina ababakoppa mu kwewaayo kwabwe eri Katonda, tebaalina abakuuma olukalala lw’abalonde.

Bwereere ekiragiro kyali kinywezezza enteekateeka ey’Obwakatonda, omulanga ogw’Obwakatonda. Nsaba. Okuva mu kukaabirira Katonda okw’amaanyi era okubala ebibala, baakyusa amaaso gaabwe eri bakatonda ab’amawanga, ne bakaabirira bwereere okuddibwamu okutaasobola kujja. Era bwe batyo ne bagwa mu mbeera eyo etaliimu Katonda era ey’ennaku, efiirwa ekigendererwa kyayo mu bulamu ng’enkolagana ne Katonda Ataggwaawo ekutuse. Enteekateeka yaabwe ey’okusaba gye baali baganyuddwamu ne yeerabirwa; tebaamanya kusaba.

Nga kya njawulo nnyo ku bikolwa ebyakaayakana ku mpapula endala ez’Ekiwandiiko ekitukuvu! Amaanyi agaakolera mu Eriya ne Erisa nga kuddamu okusaba gaatuuka n’okutuuka ku ntaana yennyini. Buli omu ku bo yazuukiza omwana okuva mu bafu, era amaanyi g’enjala ne gamenyebwa. “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi.” Eriya yali muntu ddala nga ffe, naye bwe yeewaayo n’asaba enkuba ereme okutonnya, enkuba teyatonnya okumalira ddala emyaka esatu n’ekitundu. Ate n’asaba enkuba n’etonnya, omuddo n’ebisimbe byonna ne biddamu okumera. Yona yasaba ng’asibiddwa mu kyennyanja ekinene, n’atuuka ku lukalu, ng’awonyezeddwa omuyaga n’ennyanja n’ebisolo eby’omu buziba olw’amaanyi amangi ag’okusaba kwe.

Nga kyali kigazi ekirabirirwa eky’ekisa ky’okusaba nga bwe kyagabibwanga mu nteekateeka eyo ey’ekitalo! Baasabanga mu ngeri ey’ekitalo. Lwaki okusaba kwabwe tekwasobola kuwonya nteekateeka eyo okuvunda n’okufa? Si lwa kuba nti baafiirwa omuliro, ogwo awatali gwo okusaba kwonna kukyuka ne kufuuka omukolo ogutaliimu bulamu? Kyetaagisa okufuba n’okutegana n’obwegendereza okuteekateeka obubaane. Okusaba si mulimu gwa mugayaavu. Ebirungi byonna eby’omuwendo era eby’akaloosa eby’omubiri gw’okusaba bwe biba bimaze okugattibwa n’okulongoosebwa n’okutabulwa olw’okutegana n’okusekula, omuliro gwetaagibwa okusumulula obubaane n’okulinnyisa akaloosa kaabwo eri entebe ya Katonda. Omuliro ogwokya gwe gutonda omwoyo n’obulamu bw’obubaane. Awatali muliro okusaba tekulina mwoyo; kuli ng’eby’akaloosa ebifu, eby’okuvunda n’envunyu.

Okusaba okw’akaseera n’akaseera, okw’ebiseera ebimu, tekunnyikibwa mu muliro guno ogw’Obwakatonda. Kubanga omuntu asaba bw’atyo abulwa obunyiikivu obukwata Katonda, nga amaliridde obutamuta okutuusa omukisa lwe gujja. “Musabenga obutayosa,” bwe yabuulirira Omutume omukulu. Eyo ye mpisa evuga okusaba ne kuyingira mu bbumba erigatta amayinja g’ekizimbe. “Oyinza okukola ebisingawo ku kusaba ng’omaze okusaba,” bwe yagamba Dr. A. J. Gordon omutya Katonda, “naye toyinza kukola bisingawo ku kusaba okutuusa ng’omaze okusaba.” Ebyafaayo by’obuwanguzi bwonna obukulu obw’Ekikristaayo bye byafaayo by’okusaba okuddibwamu.

“Ekitone ekisinga obukulu n’obulungi Katonda ky’awa omusajja oba omukazi yenna mu nsi muno kye kitone ky’okusaba,” bw’awandiika Principal Alexander Whyte. “Era amagoba agasinga obulungi omusajja oba omukazi yenna g’akomyawo eri Katonda bw’alijja okubalaŋŋanya ku nkomerero y’ensi eno bwe bulamu obw’okusaba. Era abaddu abo be basinga okuteeka ensimbi za Mukama waabwe “mu bbanka” abo abazuukuka mu makya ennyo ne batuula ekiro ennyo, ebbanga lyonna lye bamala mu nsi muno, nga bulijjo bazuula era bulijjo bagoberera engeri ez’okusaba ezigenda zisinga obulungi, era nga bulijjo bazimba empisa z’okusaba ez’ekyama okusingawo, ezinywevu okusingawo, era ezibala ebibala eby’omwoyo okusingawo, okutuusa lwe “basaba obutayosa,” era okutuusa lwe batandika buli kiseera emirimu emipya mu kusaba, n’obuwanguzi obupya, n’obugagga obupya.”

Martin Luther, bwe yabuuzibwa omulundi gumu enteekateeka ze ez’olunaku olwaddako bwe zaali, yaddamu nti: “Mirimu, mirimu, okuva mu makya ennyo okutuusa ekiro. Mazima, nnina bingi nnyo eby’okukola ne kiba nti essaawa ssatu ezisooka nzija kuzimala mu kusaba.” Ne Cromwell yakkirizanga mu kufukamira ennyo. Bwe yali atunuulira ebifaananyi by’abantu abatutumufu ku mulundi ogumu, yakyukira mukwano gwe n’agamba nti: “Ekyange kikole nga nfukamidde, kubanga bwe ntyo bwe natuuka ku kitiibwa.”

Omutima gwonna bwe gukwatibwa okwagala okw’amaanyi okw’okusaba, olwo lwokka omuliro oguleeta obulamu lwe gukka, kubanga tewali afuna kutuuka ku kutu kwa Katonda okuggyako omuntu omunyiikivu.

fields.title: Tetulina Kubanga Tetusaba
fields.body_html:
Bw’owulira ng’osinga okuba nga toyagala kusaba, tokkiriza nneewulira eyo, wabula fuba era gezaako okusaba ne bw’oba ng’olowooza nti toyinza kusaba.—Hildersam

Mu Bapaazi waaliwo empisa nti tewali yali awa baana be mmere yonna ku makya nga tannalaba ntuuyo ku maaso gaabwe, era ojja kukizuula nti eno ye ngeri ya Katonda eya bulijjo: obutawa baana be kuloza ku bisanyusa bye okutuusa lwe batandika okutuuyana nga babinoonya.—Richard Baxter

Mu buvunaanyizibwa bwonna Obukristaayo bwe bulagira, tewali businga bukulu era nga businga okulagajjalirwa okusinga okusaba. Abantu abasinga balowooza nti omulimu guno mukolo gwa kukooya, gwe balina eddembe okusalako nga bwe kisoboka. Ne abo abasaba olw’omulimu gwabwe oba olw’okutya kwabwe, basaba n’obunafu era n’ebirowoozo ebibuna ne kiba nti okusaba kwabwe, mu kifo ky’okuleeta emikisa, kwongera bwongezi omusango gwabwe.—Fenelon

Okusaba okungi era okusingawo obulungi kye kyama ky’ensonga yonna. Ebiseera ebisingawo eby’okusaba, okwagala n’okwetegeka okusingawo okusisinkana Katonda, okussa ekimu ne Katonda okuyita mu Kristo—kino kirimu ensonga yonna. Engeri yaffe ey’okusaba n’ebyo bye tusaba tebitusaanira. Embeera n’enkolagana ya Katonda n’Omwana ye nkolagana ey’olubeerera eya Taata n’Omwana, ey’okusaba n’okugaba—Omwana bulijjo ng’asaba, Kitaffe bulijjo ng’agaba:

Nsaba, nange ndikuwa amawanga gonna okuba obusika bwo,

era n’ensi yonna gy’ekoma okuba amatwale go.

Olibafugisa omuggo ogw’ekyuma,

era olibabetenta ng’entamu y’omubumbi.

Yesu ajja kubeeranga ng’asaba bulijjo ng’ayita mu bantu be. “Abantu bamwegayiririrenga era bamusabirenga emikisa buli lunaku.” “Kubanga ennyumba yange eriyitibwa nnyumba ya kusabiramu eri amawanga gonna.” Tulina okwetegeka okusaba; okufaanana nga Kristo, okusaba nga Kristo.

Okutuuka kw’omuntu eri Katonda mu kusaba kuggulawo buli kintu, era kufuula obwavu bwe obugagga bwe. Byonna bibye olw’okusaba. Obugagga n’ekitiibwa—byonna bya Kristo. Ekitangaala nga bwe kyeyongera okwaka era bannabbi nga bwe bategeera embeera y’okuzzibwawo, ekiwandiiko eky’Obwakatonda kirabika nga kigaziwa. “Bw’ati bw’ayogera Mukama Omutukuvu wa Isirayiri era Omutonzi we”: mumubuuze ebigenda okujja, ebikwata ku batabani be, era mumulagire ku bikwata ku mirimu gy’emikono gye. “Nze nakola ensi ne ngitonderamu abantu. Emikono gyange gyennyini gye gyayanjuluza eggulu, era ne ndagira eby’omu bwengula byonna bitondebwewo.”

Omuntu aweereddwa okulagira Katonda, n’obuyinza buno bwonna n’amaanyi, mu ebyo Obwakabaka bwa Katonda obw’oku nsi bye bwetaaga. Eggulu, n’ebyo byonna bye lirina, liri wansi w’omusolo okutuukiriza ebigendererwa bya Katonda eby’enkomerero, ebisembayo era eby’ekitiibwa. Kale lwaki ekiseera kiwanvu bwe kityo mu kutuukiriza emikisa gino egy’amagezi eri omuntu? Kale lwaki ekibi kifugira ebbanga eddene bwe lityo? Lwaki ebisuubizo by’endagaano eyalayirirwa bitwala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo okutuuka ku nkomerero yaabyo ey’ekisa? Ekibi kifuga, Setaani afuga, okusinda kwe kulamba obulamu bw’abangi; amaziga gonna gakyali mabisi era mangi.

Lwaki byonna biri bwe bityo? Tetusabye bubi bukome; tetusabye nga bwe tulina okusaba. Tetutuukirizza bukwakkulizo bwa kusaba.

Nsaba. Saba Katonda. Tetwesigamye ku kusaba. Tetufudde kusaba bukwakkulizo bwokka. Obukwakkulizo obusookerwako obw’okusaba bwamenyebwa. Tetusabye bulungi. Tetusabye n’akatono. Katonda mwetegefu okugaba, naye ffe tuli balwawo okusaba. Omwana, ng’ayita mu batukuvu be, bulijjo asaba, ne Katonda Kitaffe bulijjo addamu.

Nsaba. Mu kuyita kuno mulimu obukakafu bw’okuddibwamu; eddoboozi ery’obuwanguzi liri omwo era liyinza okuwulirwa okutu okuwuliriza. Kitaffe akutte obuyinza n’amaanyi mu mikono gye. Obukwakkulizo nga bwangu nnyo, naye nga tulwawo nnyo okutuukiriza obukwakkulizo! Amawanga gali mu buddu; ensi gy’ekoma ekyali tennafugibwa. Ensi esinda; ensi ekyali mu buddu; Setaani n’obubi bye bifuga.

Kitaffe yeeteeka mu mbeera y’Omugabi, Nsaba, era okwegayirira okwo eri Katonda Kitaffe kuwa amaanyi ebikola byonna, kuluŋŋamya entambula zonna. Enjiri yaluŋŋamizibwa Katonda. Emabega w’okuluŋŋamizibwa kwayo kwonna waliwo okusaba. Nsaba kiri emabega w’entambula zonna. Ng’ekirabo eky’Omwana atuuziddwa ku ntebe, waliwo endagaano ya Kitaffe eyalayirirwa, “Nsaba, nange ndikuwa amawanga gonna okuba obusika bwo, era n’ensi yonna gy’ekoma okuba amatwale go.” “Abantu bamwegayiririrenga era bamusabirenga emikisa buli lunaku.”

Okusaba kw’abantu abatukuvu bulijjo kulinnya eri Katonda nga kuwunya akaloosa ng’obubaane obusinga obulungi. Era Katonda mu ngeri nnyingi atwogerera, ng’alangirira obugagga bwe n’obwavu bwaffe. “Nze Mutonzi wa byonna; obugagga n’ekitiibwa byange. Mundagire.”

Tusobola okukola byonna nga Katonda atuyamba, era tusobola okufuna obuyambi bwe bwonna nga tusaba. Enjiri, mu buwanguzi bwayo n’amaanyi gaayo, yeesigamye ku busobozi bwaffe okusaba. Enteekateeka za Katonda zeesigamye ku busobozi bw’omuntu okusaba. Tusobola okufuna byonna Katonda by’alina. Mundagire. Kino si kirowoozo kya kweyiiyizza, si kirooto kya bwereere, si kwegomba kwa bwereere. Obulamu bw’Ekkanisa bwe bulamu obusingayo. Omulimu gwayo kwe kusaba. Obulamu bwayo obw’okusaba bwe bulamu obusingayo, obusinga akaloosa, obusinga okulabika.

Ekitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa tekyogera ku kusaba ng’omulimu omukulu, obuweereza obutukuvu, wabula kyogera nnyo ku kusaba mu maanyi gaakwo amakuŋŋaanye. Ge maanyi g’okusaba agabeera amalamu bulijjo era agasaba bulijjo; kwe kusaba kw’abatukuvu bonna nga kugenda ng’amaanyi amangi era amalamu, ate ng’emimwa egyayogera ebigambo gisirise era nga gisibiddwa mu kufa, ng’ekkanisa ennamu erina amaanyi g’okukkiriza okusikira amaanyi g’okusaba kwonna okw’edda n’okukufuula okutafa.

Ekyo ekyogerwa omufirosoofo Omubatisti, John Foster, kirimu amagezi agasinga obulongoofu n’amazima ga Katonda amangu, kubanga Katonda talina maanyi malala era tasaba bukwakkulizo bulala wabula okusaba. “Okusaba okungi era okusingawo obulungi kujja kuleetera omulimu gwa Katonda obuwanguzi obusinga obukakafu n’obwangu; okusaba okunafu, okw’omukolo obukolo, okutaliimu bunyiikivu, kuleeta okuvunda n’okufa. Ekkanisa ennanga yaayo eyeesigika eri mu kisenge eky’okusabiramu; amaterekero gaayo g’ebyokulwanyisa gali omwo.”

“Nkakasa,” Foster bw’agenda mu maaso, “nti buli muntu, wakati mu nteekateeka ze enkulu, ategeezeddwa nti yeesigamye ku Katonda ddala ng’obwesigame obwo bwe buli mu mazima, ajja kukubirizibwa okusaba era ajja kwagala nnyo okusikiriza mikwano gye egy’omu mazima okusaba kumpi buli ssaawa. Tajja, awatali kwo, kwesuubiza buwanguzi bwonna obw’ekitiibwa, okusinga omuvuzi w’eryato bwe yandisuubidde okutuuka ku lubalama oluli ewala ng’ayanjuluzza amatanga ge ng’empewo tekunta.

“Ndaze okutya kwange nti kirooto okusuubira obuwanguzi obutali bwa bulijjo mu kuddukanya eddiini mu bantu okuggyako nga waliwo obubonero obutali bwa bulijjo: kale omwoyo ogw’okusaba ogusinga ennyo amaanyi gwandibadde akabonero ng’ako; era omuntu eyandimalirira okugezesa amaanyi gaakwo agasembayo okusoboka, oboolyawo yandizudde nga yeeyongera okufuuka omukozi asinga okuwangula mu kitundu kye ekitono. Era singa abayigirizwa b’Obukristaayo bonna, oba abasinga obungi, baali n’okumalirira okunyiikivu era okutakyuka, buli omu okwegatta, nti eggulu terirema kuwa wadde amaanyi gamu agandifunibwa okufuba okusembayo okw’okwegayirira okw’awamu era okugumiikiriza, kyandibadde kabonero nti enkyukakyuka y’ensi yonna eri kumpi.”

Edward Payson, omu ku bantu ba Katonda ddala, ayogera ku kigambo kino ekya Foster nti, “Abaminsani batono nnyo okuva ku batume, oboolyawo, abagezezzaako okugezesa kuno. Oyo alisooka okukugezesa, nzikiriza, alikola eby’ekitalo. Tewali kye nnyinza kuwandiika, tewali malayika ky’ayinza kuwandiika, ekyandimwetaagisizza oyo alikola okugezesa kuno.

“Ekimu ku bivudde mu bumanyirivu obutono bwe nnina ng’omubuulizi Omukristaayo kwe kukakasa nti eddiini erimu nnyo okuwa Katonda ekifo ekyo mu ndowooza zaffe ne mu nneewulira zaffe, ky’alina ddala mu bwengula bwonna. Tumanyi nti mu bwengula bwonna ye byonna mu byonna. Nga bw’abeera bulijjo byonna mu byonna gye tuli, era nga bwe tugondera ekiragiro Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli kye yawa emmeeme ye, “Emmeeme yange ewummulire mu Katonda yekka;” bwe tutyo, nga bwe ndowooza, bwe tuba tukulaakulanye okutuuka ku butuukirivu. Kyangu mu ngeri emu okulindirira Katonda; naye okumulindirira yekka—okuwulira, ku bikwata ku maanyi gaffe, essanyu lyaffe, n’okugasa kwaffe, ng’ebitonde byonna n’ensonga ez’okubiri bisaanyiziddwawo, era nga tuli ffekka mu bwengula ne Katonda, nga ndowooza, kye kintu ekizibu era ekitali kya bulijjo okutuukako. Wakiri, nkakasa nti kye kimu kye ndi wala nnyo okukituukako. Nga bwe tutuuka ku kino, bwe tutyo bwe tujja okusanga buli kintu nga kyangu; kubanga tujja kufuuka, mu ngeri ey’amaanyi, abantu ab’okusaba; era tuyinza okwogera ku kusaba nga Sulemaani bw’ayogera ku nsimbi, nti kusobola byonna.”

John Foster oyo yennyini yagamba, bwe yali anaatera okufa: “Sisabangako n’obunyiikivu bwe nti, wadde, oboolyawo, emirundi emingi egy’obwesigwa bwe gityo. “Musabenga obutayosa” kye kigambo ekibadde kiddiŋŋana mu birowoozo ebisirifu, era nkakasa nti kirina okuba empisa yange okutuusa essaawa esembayo ey’obulamu nga nkyategeera. Woowe, lwaki si mu myaka gino ataano egiyise egy’obugayaavu, egitaliimu bulamu?”

Era naye eyo ye ngeri ffenna gye tukolamu ku bikwata ku kusaba. Newankubadde tumanyi obukulu bwakwo, obukulu bwakwo obw’obulamu n’okufa, naye tuleka essaawa ne ziyitawo nga tezirina kye zikoze, ne tuyinza okukungubagira kyokka mu kufa okufiirwa okutaddizibwawo.

Bwe tufumiitiriza mu kasirise ku kya mazima nti okukulaakulana kw’Obwakabaka bwa Mukama waffe kwesigamye ku kusaba, kya nnaku okulowooza nti tuwa ebiseera bitono nnyo omulimu guno omutukuvu. Buli kintu kyesigamye ku kusaba, era naye tukulagajjalira si ku lw’okwonoona obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo kwokka, wabula n’okulwisa n’okukosa omulimu gwa Mukama waffe ku nsi. Amaanyi g’obulungi n’ag’obubi galwanira ensi. Singa twagala, twandyongedde ku maanyi ag’okuwangula ag’eggye ery’obutuukirivu, era naye emimwa gyaffe gisibiddwa, emikono gyaffe giwanikiddwa bwereere ku mabbali gaffe, era tussa mu kabi omulimu gwennyini gwe twogera nti tugufaako nnyo, olw’okwewala ekisenge eky’okusabiramu.

Okusaba bwe bukwakkulizo obumu obukulu obw’olubeerera Kitaffe bw’asuubiza okuwa Omwana ensi okuba eyiye. Kristo asaba ng’ayita mu bantu be. Singa wabaddewo okusaba okw’okulemerako, okwa bonna era okutakoma okw’abantu ba Katonda, edda ddala ensi yandibadde efugiddwa ku lwa Kristo. Okulwawo tekunnyonnyolwa nziyiza ezaasimba amakanda, wabula obutabaawo kusaba okutuufu. Tukola nnyo buli kintu ekirala okusinga okusaba. Newankubadde okugaba kwaffe kutono, ensimbi ze tuwaayo zisinga ebiweebwayo byaffe eby’okusaba. Oboolyawo mu kibiina ky’abasinza ekya bulijjo, abantu ataano bayamba mu kusasula, ng’emmeeme emu entukuvu era eyaka yokka y’eyeggalira ne Katonda n’emeggana olw’okununulibwa kw’ensi y’abatamanyi Katonda. Okusaba okw’omukolo ku mikolo egyateekebwawo oba egy’eggwanga tekubalibwa mu kubalirira kuno. Tussa essira ku bintu ebirala okusinga ku bwetaavu bw’okusaba.

Tusaba essaala mu ngeri entegeke, naye ensi tetugirina mu mukono gw’okukkiriza kwaffe. Tetusaba mu ngeri etambuza Katonda era ereeta amaanyi gonna ag’Obwakatonda okutuyamba. Ensi yeetaaga okusaba okw’amazima okusingawo okugiwonya obufuzi n’okuzikirizibwa kwa Setaani.

Tetusaba nga Eriya bwe yasaba. John Foster ensonga yonna agituusa ku kye tuyinza okukola. “Ekkanisa ya Katonda,” bw’agamba, “bw’eriba ezuukuse okumanya obuvunaanyizibwa bwayo n’emirimu gyayo n’okukkiriza okutuufu okusaba ekyo Kristo ky’asuubizza—“buli kye munaasabanga”—enkyukakyuka ey’amaanyi ejja kubaawo.”

Naye si buli kusaba nti kwe kusaba. Amaanyi agavuga, amaanyi agawangula mu mulimu gwa Katonda ye Katonda yennyini. “Mumpite n’abayitaba ne mbalaga ebikulu ebitanoonyezeka bye mutamanyi,” kwe kusoomooza kwa Katonda eri okusaba. Okusaba kuleeta Katonda n’amaanyi ge gonna mu mulimu gwa Katonda. Katonda bw’agamba nti tumubuuze ebigenda okujja, ebikwata ku batabani be, era tumulagire ku bikwata ku mirimu gy’emikono gye—eyo ye carte blanche ya Katonda eri okusaba. Okukkiriza kuba kwa buyinza bwonna nga kufukamidde kwokka, era emikono gyakwo egyanjuluziddwa nga gikwata ku Katonda, olwo kuwolereza okutuuka ku kusoboka kwa Katonda kwonna; kubanga okukkiriza okusaba kwokka kwe kuyinza okufuna ku Katonda ekyo kye yasuubiza nti “buli kye munaasabanga.” Omukazi Omusulofoyiniiki, nnamwandu eyalemerako, n’omukwano eyajja mu ttumbi, masomo ga kitalo ag’ekyo okusaba okutatya kye kuyinza okukola mu kufuga oba mu kusoomooza embeera, mu kukyusa okuwangulwa ne kufuuka obuwanguzi, n’okuwangula mu bitundu eby’okuggwaamu essuubi. Okubeera omu ne Kristo, entikko y’okutuuka mu by’omwoyo, kwa kitiibwa mu bintu byonna; kusinga ekitiibwa mu kuba nti olwo tusobola “okusaba buli kye tunaasabanga, ne kitukolerwanga.” Okusaba mu linnya lya Yesu kuteeka engule esinga ku Katonda, kubanga kumugulumiza okuyita mu Mwana era kusuubizisa Omwana okuwa abantu “buli kye munaasabanga n’ekintu kyonna” bye banaasaba.

Mu Ndagaano Empya okusaba okw’ekitalo okw’Endagaano Enkadde kuteekebwa mu maaso kulyoke kusikirize era kukubirize okusaba kwaffe, era kukulemberwa okulangirira, amaanyi gaakwo agakola ge tutasobola kunnyonnyola bulungi. “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi. Eriya yali muntu ddala nga ffe, naye bwe yeewaayo n’asaba enkuba ereme okutonnya, enkuba teyatonnya okumalira ddala emyaka esatu n’ekitundu. Ate n’asaba enkuba n’etonnya, omuddo n’ebisimbe byonna ne biddamu okumera.”

Obutono bw’ebivaamu byaffe, ensibuko y’obukovvu bwonna, bunnyonnyolwa Omutume Yakobo—“Mwagala ebintu ne mutabifuna ... kubanga mulemeddwa okubisaba. Era ne bwe mubisaba, temubifuna kubanga ekigendererwa kyammwe kikyamu; mugenderera kubikozesa ku masanyu gokka.”

Ago ge mazima gonna mu bufunze.

fields.title: Abasajja Abaasabanga n’Ekigendererwa
fields.body_html:
Amaanyi g’okusaba gawangudde amaanyi g’omuliro; gaziyizza obukambwe bw’empologoma, gakkakkanyizza obujagalalo, gakomezza entalo, gakkakkanyizza ebintu eby’obutonde, gagobye dayimooni, gakutudde enjegere z’okufa, gagaziyizza emiryango gy’eggulu, gawonyezza endwadde, gaziyizza obukuusa, galokodde ebibuga okuzikirizibwa, gayimirizza enjuba mu kkubo lyayo, era ne gaziyiza okukuba kwa laddu. Okusaba bye byokulwanyisa ebijjuvu ebikola mu byonna, eky’obugagga ekitakendeera, ekirombe ekitaggwaamu, eggulu eritabikkiddwa bire, eggulu eritatabulwa kibuyaga. Kye kikolo, ye nsulo, ye nnyina w’emikisa lukumi.—Chrysostom

Essaala z’abantu abatukuvu zikkakkanya obusungu bwa Katonda, zigoba ebikemo, ziziyiza Setaani ne zimuwangula, zifuna obuweereza n’obuyambi bwa bamalayika, ziggyawo ebiragiro bya Katonda. Okusaba kuwonya endwadde era kufuna okusonyiyibwa; kuyimiriza enjuba mu kkubo lyayo era kuyimiriza nnamuziga z’eggaali ly’omwezi; kufuga bakatonda bonna era kuggulawo ne kuggalawo amawanika g’enkuba, kusumulula olubuto era kuzikiza amaanyi g’omuliro; kuziba emimwa gy’empologoma era kugumya obusobozi bwaffe obubonaabona era obunafu mu maaso g’amaanyi g’okubonyaabonyezebwa n’amaanyi g’okuyigganyizibwa; kusanyusa Katonda era kutuwa byonna bye twetaaga.—Jeremy Taylor

Ebintu bingi bikolebwa okusaba Okusinga ensi eno bw’eroota. noolwekyo,

eddoboozi lyo
Ka lyambuke ng’ensulo ku lwange emisana n’ekiro.
Kubanga abantu basinga ki endiga oba embuzi,
Ezirisa obulamu obuzibe mu bwongo,
Bwe baba nga bamanyi Katonda, naye tebayimusa mikono gya kusaba
Ku lwabwe bennyini ne ku lw’abo ababayita mikwano?
Kubanga bwe kityo ensi yonna enneekulungirivu mu buli ngeri
Esibiddwa n’enjegere eza zaabu ku bigere bya Katonda.—Tennyson

Okusaba okutuukiridde linnya ddala eddala ery’okwagala.—Fenelon

Kyayogerwa ku C. H. Spurgeon, eyafa, nti yavanga mu kuseka n’ayingira mu kusaba mu ngeri ey’obutonde ng’omuntu abeera mu byombi. Gy’ali, empisa y’okusaba yali ya ddembe, nga tesibiddwa. Obulamu bwe tebwali bwawuddwamu bisenge, nga kimu kiggaddwako ku kirala mu ngeri enkakali eyaziyiza buli kukwatagana wakati waabyo. Yabeeranga bulijjo mu kussa kimu ne Kitaffe ow’omu Ggulu. Yabanga bulijjo ng’akwatagana ne Katonda, era bwe kityo kyamubeereranga kya bulijjo okusaba nga bwe kyali okussa omukka.

“Nga tubadde n’ekiseera ekirungi; ka twebaze Katonda olw’ekyo,” bwe yagamba mukwano gwe lumu, bwe baali bamaze okunyumirwa olunaku olw’okuwummula wabweru wansi w’eggulu eriri bbululu, nga bazingiddwa mu musana ogw’ekitiibwa, n’essanyu eritaziyizibwa ng’ery’abaana b’essomero. Okusaba kwavanga ku mimwa gye mu ngeri ey’obutonde nga bwe kwavanga okwogera okwa bulijjo, era tewabangawo n’akatono ekitakwatagana bwe yasembereranga entebe ya Katonda ng’ava butereevu mu kifo kyonna mwe yabanga.

Eyo ye mpisa ku by’okusaba esaanidde okulabibwa mu buli mwana wa Katonda. Waliwo, era wasaanidde okubaawo, ebiseera ebyateekebwawo eby’okwogera ne Katonda, nga buli kirala kiggaliddwa ebweru, ne tujja mu maaso ge okwogera naye n’okumuleka okwogera naffe; era mu biseera ebyo mwe muva empisa ennungi ey’okusaba eruka olukoba olwa zaabu wakati w’ensi n’eggulu. Awatali biseera ebyo ebyateekebwawo, empisa y’okusaba teyinza kuzimbibwa; awatali byo, obulamu obw’omwoyo tebulina kibuliisa. Mu byo, emmeeme esitulibwa n’eyingizibwa mu mbeera empya—embeera y’ekibuga eky’omu ggulu, mwe kiba ekyangu okuggulirawo Katonda omutima n’okwogera naye nga mukwano bw’ayogera ne mukwano gwe.

Bwe kityo, mu buli mbeera ey’obulamu, okusaba kwe kufuka emmeeme okusinga okuba okw’obutonde, okukyukira Katonda awatali kiziyiza olw’okussa kimu naye n’okulungamizibwa. Ka kibe mu nnaku oba mu ssanyu, mu kuwangulwa oba mu buwanguzi, mu bulamu obulungi oba mu bunafu, mu kabi oba mu kugenda bulungi, omutima gubuuka okusisinkana Katonda nga omwana bw’adduka mu mikono gya nnyina, bulijjo ng’akakasa nti gy’ali waliwo okusaasira okutuukiriza buli kye yeetaaga.

Dr. Adam Clarke, mu kitabo ky’obulamu bwe, awandiika nti Omwami Wesley bwe yali ng’addayo e Bungereza ku lyato, baalwawo nnyo olw’empewo ezaali zikunta nga zibaziyiza. Wesley yali asoma, n’awulira okusasamala ku lyato, era bwe yabuuza ekyali kibaddewo, ne bamutegeeza nti empewo yali ebaziyiza. “Kale,” bwe yaddamu, “ka tusabe.”

Dr. Clarke bwe yamala okusaba, Wesley n’atandika okwegayirira n’amaanyi, okwali ng’okuwaayo okw’okukkiriza okusinga okuba okwegomba obwegombi. “Ayi Katonda Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna era ow’emirembe n’emirembe,” bwe yasaba. “Ofuga buli wantu, era ebintu byonna bituukiriza ekigendererwa ky’okwagala kwo. Okwata empewo mu bibatu byo, otuula waggulu w’amataba, era ofuga nga Kabaka emirembe gyonna. Lagira empewo zino n’amayengo gano bikugondere, otutuuse mangu era mirembe ku mwalo gwe tugendako.”

Amaanyi g’okwegayirira kuno gaawulirwa buli muntu. Wesley yayimuka okuva ku maviivi ge, n’atabaako ky’ayogera, naye n’akwata ekitabo kye n’agenda mu maaso n’okusoma. Dr. Clarke yalinnya waggulu ku lyato, era ne yeewuunya okulaba ng’eryato ligenda n’amatanga, nga liri mu kkubo lyalyo ettuufu. Era teryakyuka okutuusa lwe lyatuuka ku mwalo mirembe. Ku kukyuka kw’empewo okw’amangu era okulungi, Wesley teyabaako ky’ayogera; yali asuubira nnyo ddala okuwulirwa ne kiba nti yakitwala nti yali awuliddwa.

Okwo kwali kusaba okulina ekigendererwa—okwogera okutegeerekeka era okutereevu okw’omuntu eyamanya nti Katonda amuwuliriza, era nti Katonda yalina okwagala wamu n’obuyinza okumuwa ekyo kye yamusaba.

Major D. W. Whittle, mu nnyanjula ye ku byewuunyo by’okusaba, ayogera ku George Muller ow’e Bristol nti: “Nnasisinkana Omwami Muller ku ofiisi y’ebintu ebisindikibwa amangu, ku makya g’olunaku lwe twasaabalirako okuva e Quebec okugenda e Liverpool. Nga wasigaddeyo ng’ekitundu kya ssaawa eryato ettono litwale abasaabaze ku meeri, yabuuza omukozi waayo obanga entebe ey’oku meeri yali emutuukidde okuva e New York. Ne bamuddamu nti, “Nedda,” ne bamugamba nti teyandisobodde kutuuka mu budde bwa meeri. Nnalina entebe gye nnali nnaakagula, ne mbuulira Omwami Muller ekifo ekyali okumpi, ne mmuwa amagezi, okuva bwe wali wasigaddeyo eddakiika ntono, nti yandigulidde emu amangu ago. Yaddamu nti, “Nedda, muganda wange. Kitaffe ow’omu Ggulu ajja kusindika entebe okuva e New York. Y’ekozesebwa Mukyala Muller. Nnawandiikira ow’oluganda ennaku kkumi emabega, eyasuubiza okulaba ng’esindikibwa wano wiiki ewedde. Tabadde wa bwangu nga bwe nnandyagadde, naye nkakasa nti Kitaffe ow’omu Ggulu ajja kusindika entebe. Mukyala Muller alwala nnyo ku nnyanja, era yeegomba nnyo okuba n’entebe eyo yennyini, era bwe tutagisanze wano jjo, tusabye essaala ey’enjawulo nti Kitaffe ow’omu Ggulu asiime okugituwa, era tujja kumwesiga okukikola.” Omusajja ono omwagalwa owa Katonda bwe yalinnya ku meeri mu mirembe, ng’akkiriza Mukyala Muller okuyinza okutambula olugendo awatali ntebe, so nga ku ddoola bbiri zokka yandifunye emu, njatula nti nnatya nti Omwami Muller yali atwala emisingi gy’okukkiriza kwe wala nnyo era nga takola na magezi. Nnasigala ku ofiisi eddakiika kkumi oluvannyuma lw’Omwami Muller okugenda. Bwe nnali nga ntandika okwanguwa okugenda ku mwalo, eggaali erisikibwa embalaasi lyajja mu luguudo, era waggulu ku mugugu ogwali gwakatuuka okuva e New York nga waliwo entebe y’Omwami Muller. Yasindikibwa amangu ago ku lyato ettono n’eteekebwa mu mikono gyange ngitwalire Omwami Muller, eryato nga lyakava ku mwalo (Mukama yalina essomo lye yali anjigiriza). Omwami Muller yagikwata n’essanyu ng’ery’omwana eyakafuna ekirungi ky’asiima ennyo, era n’aggyako enkofiira ye n’ekitiibwa, n’akwata engalo ze waggulu waayo, ne yeebaza Kitaffe ow’omu Ggulu olw’okusindika entebe.”

Omu ku abo abaawandiikiganyanga ne Melancthon awandiika ku kusaba kwa Luther nti: “Sisobola kwewuunya kimala essanyu, obugumiikiriza, okukkiriza n’essuubi eby’enjawulo eby’omusajja ono mu biseera bino ebizibu era ebitawaanya. Aliisa bulijjo ebiwulirwa bino eby’ekisa ng’asoma Ekigambo kya Katonda n’obunyiikivu bungi. Era tewayita lunaku lumu nga tamaze mu kusaba waakiri essaawa ssatu ku ze zisinga obulungi. Lumu nnamuwulira ng’asaba. Ayi Katonda ow’ekisa! Nga mulimu omwoyo n’okukkiriza bingi mu bigambo bye! Yeegayirira Katonda n’ekitiibwa kingi ng’ali mu maaso ga Katonda, naye era n’essuubi n’obwesige obunywevu nga bw’andyogedde ne kitaawe oba mukwano gwe. “Mmanyi,” bwe yagamba, “nti Ggwe Kitaffe era Katonda waffe; noolwekyo nkakasa nti ojja kumalawo abayigganya abaana bo. Kubanga singa olemwa okukola kino, ensonga yo ggwe, olw’okuba egattiddwa ku yaffe, yandibadde mu kabi. Nsonga yo ggwe ddala. Ffe, olw’okulabirira kwo, twawalirizibwa okwetaba mu yo. Noolwekyo ggwe ojja kuba bukuumi bwaffe.” Bwe nnali mpuliriza Luther ng’asaba bw’atyo, nga ndi wala, emmeeme yange yali ng’ekwata omuliro munda mu nze, okuwulira omusajja ng’ayogera ne Katonda nga mukwano gwe, naye n’obukkakkamu n’ekitiibwa bingi; era n’okumuwulira, mu kusaba kwe, ng’anywerera ku bisuubizo ebiri mu Zabbuli, ng’akakasa nti ebyo by’asaba bijja kuweebwa.”

Ku William Bramwell, omubuulizi Omumethodisti eyamanyika ennyo e Bungereza, eyewuunyisa olw’obunyiikivu bwe n’okusaba, sajenti meeja ayogera bino: “Mu Julaayi, 1811, eggye lyaffe lyalagirwa okugenda e Spain, mu kiseera ekyo ekifo ky’olutalo oluwanvu era olw’okuyiwa omusaayi. Omutima gwange gwatawaanyizibwa nnyo olw’okulowooza okuleka mukyala wange omwagalwa n’abaana bange bana abatalina bwe beeyamba mu nsi engwira, nga tebalina abakuuma wadde ababalabirira. Omwami Bramwell yafaayo nnyo ku mbeera yaffe, era omwoyo gwe ogusaasira gwali ng’ogunywa ennaku yonna ey’omukyala wange omugonvu. Yeegayiriranga ku ntebe ey’ekisa emisana n’ekiro ku lwaffe. Nze ne mukyala wange twayita akawungeezi akaakulembera olugendo lwaffe mu nnyumba ya mukwano gwaffe, wamu n’Omwami Bramwell, eyatuula ng’alowooza nnyo, era ng’alabika ng’ali mu kulwana okw’omwoyo ekiseera kyonna. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyeggulo, amangu ago n’aggya omukono gwe mu kifuba kye, n’aguteeka ku kugulu kwange, n’agamba nti: “Ow’oluganda Riley, wuliriza bulungi kye ŋŋenda okwogera! Tojja kugenda Spain. Jjukira kye nkugamba, tojja kugenda; kubanga mbadde nneegayirira Katonda n’amaanyi ku lulwo, era Kitaffe ow’omu Ggulu bw’akkiriza mu kusaasira kwe okumpa amaanyi okumukwatako Ye yennyini, simuta mangu; nedda, okutuusa lw’ampa okuddibwamu. Noolwekyo oyinza okukakasa nti omulundi oguddako bwe ndiwulira okuva gy’oli, ojja kuba ng’obeera mu nkambi wano.” Kino kyatuukirira ddala nga bwe yagamba. Ku lunaku olwaddirira ekiragiro eky’okugenda e Spain kyasazibwamu.”

Abasajja bano baasabanga n’ekigendererwa. Gye bali, Katonda teyali wala, mu kitundu ekimu ekitatuukikako, wabula yali kumpi, bulijjo nga mwetegefu okuwuliriza okukaaba kw’abaana be. Tewaaliwo kiziyiza wakati. Baali ba kumpi nnyo ddala, singa omuntu ayinza okukozesa ebigambo ebyo ku muntu n’Omutonzi we. Tewaali kire kyabikka maaso ga Kitaffe eri omwana we amwesiga, eyasobolanga okutunula waggulu mu maaso ga Katonda n’afukumula ebyo omutima gwe bye gwegomba. Era ogwo gwe mutindo gw’okusaba Katonda gw’atalemwa kuwulira. Amanyi nti kuva mu mutima ogumu n’ogugwe; okuva eri omuntu eyeewaddeyo ddala eri enteekateeka ey’omu ggulu, era bw’atyo atega okutu kwe n’awa omwana amwegayirira obukakafu nti ekyo ky’asaba kiwuliddwa era kiddiddwamu.

Ffenna tetwalabako ku bintu nga bino bwe twasemberera amaaso ga Kitaffe n’ekigendererwa ekinywevu ekitakyukakyuka? Mu bulumi obw’amaanyi obw’emmeeme, twanoonya obuddukiro okuva mu kunyigirizibwa kw’ensi mu kisenge eky’omu maaso eky’eggulu; amayengo g’okuggwaamu essuubi gaalabika ng’agatiisa okutuzikiriza, era ng’ekkubo ery’okuwona teririna wonna we lirabika, twaddukira, ng’abayigirizwa ab’edda, ku buyinza bwa Mukama waffe, nga tumukaabirira atulokole tuleme kusaanawo. Awo mu kaseera akatono ennyo, ekyo ne kikolebwa. Amayengo ne gakkakkana; empewo eyawuuma n’ekkakkana ku kiragiro kya Katonda; obulumi bw’emmeeme ne bufuuka emirembe egiwummuza, ng’omuntu wonna ayingiddwamu okumanya nti Katonda ali awo, nga kuleeta obukakafu nti okusaba kuddiddwamu era n’okununulibwa okulungi.

“Mbuulira Mukama ebinteganya n’ebizibu byange, ne mmulindirira ampe eby’okubiddamu,” bw’ayogera omusajja omu owa Katonda. “Era kyewuunyisa nga ensonga eyalabikanga ng’ey’ekizikiza ennyo bw’efuuka entangaavu ng’endabirwamu mu kusaba olw’obuyambi bw’Omwoyo wa Katonda. Ndowooza Abakristaayo balemwa emirundi mingi okufuna okuddibwamu kw’essaala zaabwe kubanga tebalindirira Katonda kimala. Bafukamira bufukamizi ne boogera ebigambo bitono, ne bayimuka amangu ne beerabira, ne basuubira Katonda okubaddamu. Okusaba okw’engeri eyo bulijjo kunzijukiza omulenzi omuto akuba ekide ku mulyango gwa muliraanwa we, n’oluvannyuma n’adduka n’amaanyi ge gonna.”

Bwe tufuna empisa y’okusaba, tuyingira mu mbeera empya. “Osuubira okugenda mu ggulu?” omuntu omu bwe yabuuza Omuskooti eyali atya Katonda. “Ssebo, mbeera eyo,” kwe kwali okuddamu okw’ekyewuunyo era okutasuubirwa. Kyali kigambo kimpi ekiraga amazima amakulu, kubanga ekkubo lyonna erigenda mu ggulu ye ggulu eritandise eri Omukristaayo atambula okumpi ne Katonda ekimala okuwulira ebyama by’alina okumubikkulira.

Embeera eno eragibwa bulungi mu lugero lwa Horace Bushnell, olwanyumizibwa Dr. Parkes Cadman. Bushnell yazuulibwa ng’alina obulwadde obutawona. Akawungeezi akamu Omusumba Joseph Twichell yamukyalira, era bwe baali batudde wamu wansi w’eggulu ery’emmunyeenye, Bushnell n’agamba nti: “Omu ku ffe asaanidde okusaba.” Twichell n’asaba Bushnell asabe, Bushnell n’atandika okusaba kwe; ng’akubye amaaso ge wansi ku ttaka, n’afukumula omutima gwe okutuusa, nga Twichell bwe yagamba ng’ajjukira ekyo ekyaliwo, “Nnatya okugolola omukono gwange mu kizikiza nneme okukwata ku Katonda.”

Okubeera ne Katonda okumpi bw’atyo kwe kuyingira mu Watukuvu Ennyo—okussa akawoowo k’empewo ey’omu ggulu, okutambula mu nnimiro ennungi eza Edeni. Tewali kirala wabula okusaba ekiyinza okuleeta Katonda n’omuntu mu kussa kimu kuno okw’essanyu. Ekyo kye kyali ekyamutuukako Samuel Rutherford, nga bwe kibeera eri buli ayita mu mulyango gwe gumu. Omutukuvu ono owa Katonda bwe yasibwa mu kkomera omulundi gumu olw’omutima gwe ogw’omunda, yanyumirwa okubeera ne Katonda mu ngeri etatera kulabika, n’awandiika mu kitabo kye eky’ebya buli lunaku nti Yesu yayingira mu kasenge ke, era nti bwe yajja “buli jjinja lyamasamasa ng’ejjinja ery’omuwendo erimyufu.”

Abalala bangi bawadde obujulirwa ku kussa kimu kuno okulungi, okusaba bwe kwafuuka empisa emu ey’obulamu eyabagasa okusinga ekintu ekirala kyonna. David Livingstone yabeeranga mu bwakabaka bw’okusaba era yamanya amaanyi gaakwo ag’ekisa. Yalina empisa buli lunaku lwe yazaalibwako okuwandiika essaala, era ku lunaku lwe olw’okuzaalibwa olw’okubiri okuva ku lwasembayo, eno ye yali essaala ye: “Ayi Ggwe Katonda, sikwagadde n’obunyiikivu, mu buziba, era mu mazima ekimala. Nkwegayiridde, nkkiriza omwaka guno nga tegunnaggwaako mbe nga mmaze omulimu gwange.” Omwaka ogwaddirira bwe gwali gwakatandika, abasajja be abeesigwa, bwe baatunula mu kasiisira e Ilala, enkuba nga etonnya okuva ku bisasi, baalaba omukulu waabwe ng’afukamidde ku maviivi ge kumpi n’ekitanda kye ng’ali mu kusaba. Yali afiiridde ku maviivi ge ng’asaba.

Stonewall Jackson yali musajja wa kusaba. Yagamba nti: “Empisa eno nginywezezza nnyo mu birowoozo byange ne kiba nti sisitula giraasi ya mazzi ku mimwa gyange nga sisoose kusaba mukisa gwa Katonda, sisiba bbaluwa nga sitaddeeko kigambo kya kusaba wansi w’akabonero kaayo, sikwata bbaluwa okuva ku poosita nga sisindise birowoozo byange mu ggulu akaseera katono, era sikyusa bibiina byange mu kisenge ky’okusomeseramu nga sikoze—okwegayirira kwa ddakiika emu ku lw’abayizi abafuluma ne ku lw’abo abayingira.”

James Gilmour, omuminsani eyasooka okugenda e Mongolia, yali musajja wa kusaba. Mu kuwandiika kwe yalina empisa obutakozesanga kapapula akanywa bwino. Yeeteekera etteeka nti buli lwe yatuukanga wansi ku lupapula lwonna, alindirire bwino akale, era ekiseera ekyo akimale ng’asaba.

Mu ngeri eno obulamu bwabwe bwonna bwajjula ebya Katonda, era ne bafuuka ekifaananyi ekiraga akawoowo n’ekitiibwa eby’omu ggulu. Bwe tutambula ne Katonda mu makubo g’okusaba, tufuna ekitundu ku kifaananyi kye, era nga tetumanyi tufuuka abajulirwa eri abalala ab’obulungi bwe n’ekisa kye. Pulofeesa James, mu kitabo kye ekyamanyika ennyo, “Varieties of Religious Experience,” ayogera ku musajja ow’emyaka amakumi ana mu mwenda eyagamba nti: “Katonda wa ddala gye ndi okusinga ekirowoozo kyonna oba ekintu oba omuntu. Mpulira nti ali wano mu ngeri ey’enkakafu, era okusingawo bwe mbeera mu kukwatagana okusingako n’amateeka ge nga bwe gawandiikiddwa mu mubiri gwange ne mu birowoozo byange. Mmuwulira mu musana oba mu nkuba; era byonna nga bitabuddwamu emirembe egiwooma ennyo bye bisinga okunnyonnyola bye mpulira. Njogera naye nga mukwano gwange mu kusaba ne mu kutendereza, era okussa kimu kwaffe kunyuma nnyo. Anziramu emirundi n’emirundi, emirundi mingi mu bigambo ebyogerwa mu ngeri entegeerekeka bulungi ne kiba ng’okutu kwange okw’ebweru kwe kwawulira eddoboozi, naye okusinga mu birowoozo eby’amaanyi ebiteekebwa mu mutima. Ebiseera ebisinga kibeera kyawandiikibwa mu Byawandiikibwa, ekibikkula endaba empya ku Ye n’okwagala kwe gye ndi, n’okufaayo kwe ku bukuumi bwange ... Nti wange era nti ndi wuwe tekimbulako; ssanyu erisigalawo. Awatali kyo obulamu bwandibadde kifo kyereere, ddungu, olukoola olutaliiko lubalama wadde ekkubo.”

Kyewuunyisa kye kimu obujulirwa bwa Sir Thomas Browne, omusawo omwagalwa eyabeeranga e Norwich mu 1605, era eyawandiika ekitabo eky’enjawulo ennyo ekyabuna wonna, “Religio Medici.” Wadde nga Bungereza yali eyita mu kiseera eky’okukankana kw’eggwanga n’okusasamala mu by’obufuzi, yafuna okubudaabudibwa n’amaanyi mu kusaba. “Mmaliridde,” bwe yawandiika mu kitabo kye eky’ebya buli lunaku ekyazuulibwa mu biwandiiko bye eby’ekyama ng’amaze okufa, “okusaba okusingawo n’okusaba bulijjo, okusaba mu bifo byonna akasiriikiriro we kampita, mu nnyumba, ku luguudo olunene ne mu kkubo; era obutamanya kkubo oba kakubo mu kibuga kino ekitayinza kujulira nti seerabidde Katonda.” Era ayongerako nti: “Ngenderera okukozesa omukisa okusaba bwe nnaalabanga ekkanisa yonna gye nnaayitangako, Katonda asinzibwe omwo mu mwoyo, era emmeeme zirokolerwe omwo; okusabira buli lunaku abalwadde bange n’abalwadde b’abasawo abalala; bwe nnaayingiranga mu maka gonna okugamba nti, “Emirembe gya Katonda gibeere wano”; nga mmaze okuwulira okubuulira, okusabira omukisa ku mazima ga Katonda ne ku mubaka; bwe nnaalabanga omuntu omulungi mu ndabika okutendereza Katonda olw’ebitonde bye, okusabira obulungi bw’emmeeme y’omuntu oyo, Katonda amugaggawaze n’ebirungi eby’omunda, era eby’ebweru n’eby’omunda bikwatagane; bwe nnaalabanga omuntu omulema, okusaba Katonda abawe obulamba bw’emmeeme, era oluvannyuma abawe obulungi bw’okuzuukira.”

Nga kino kyakulabirako kya mwoyo ogw’okusaba! Endowooza eyo eraga okusaba obutayosa, eraga empisa y’okusaba mu kwegayirira kwakwo okutakoma, mu kussa kimu kwakwo okutaziyizibwa, mu kwegayiririra abalala kwakwo okutaggwaawo. Era nga kyakulabirako kya kigendererwa mu kusaba! Bameka ku ffe abayinza okwogerwako nti bwe tuyita abantu mu luguudo tubasabira, oba nti bwe tuyingira mu maka oba mu kkanisa tujjukira ababeeramu oba ekibiina mu kusaba eri Katonda?

Ensonga lwaki tetulowooza oba lwaki twerabira eri mu kuba nti eri bangi ku ffe okusaba kwe kwefaako kwokka mu ngeri endala; kitegeeza kusaba kintu ku lwaffe ffekka, ekyo kyokka, si kirala.

Era tulina okusaba tununulibwe mu ndowooza eyo.

fields.title: Okusaba Bukugu Obulina Okuyigibwa
fields.body_html:
Okusaba okw’okukkiriza ge maanyi gokka mu bitonde byonna Yakuwa omukulu g’agondera. Okusaba lye ddagala erisinga byonna.—Robert Hall

Ekkanisa, nga yeemalidde ku kufuna obuyinza obw’ensi, yali kumpi eyabulira emirimu gyayo egy’omwoyo, era obwakabaka bwayo, obwali buzimbiddwa ku misingi egy’omwoyo, bwali bugwa nga emisingi egyo bwe givunda, era nga butiisa okuggwaawo ng’ekirooto ekitaliimu nsa.—Lea’s Inquisition

Tusaba nga Kristo bwe yasabanga? Tubeera mu Ye? Okwegayirira kwaffe n’omwoyo gwaffe bye bijjulukuka okuva mu mwoyo gwe n’okwegayirira kwe? Okwagala kufuga omwoyo—okwagala okutuukiridde?

Ebibuuzo bino biteekwa okutwalibwa ng’ebisaanira era ebikwatagana n’ekiseera nga kino. Tutya ddala nti tukola ebintu ebirala bingi okusinga okusaba. Guno si mulembe gwa kusaba; mulembe gwa mirimu mingi, gwa bibiina binene, naye nga mu gwo waliwo okusika okw’amaanyi ennyo okussa essira ku birabika n’ebyensi, n’okulagajjalira n’okunyoomoola ebitalabika n’eby’omwoyo. Okusaba ge maanyi agasinga gonna, kubanga kuwa Katonda ekitiibwa era kumuleeta okuyamba mu ngeri ey’amaanyi.

Tewali kiyinza kudda mu kifo ky’okusaba, tewali kikuvuganya; kuyimiridde kwokka ng’amaanyi amanene ag’omwoyo, era amaanyi gano galina okubaawo n’okukola. Tegayinza kulekebwa mu mulembe gumu, wadde okuyimirizibwa olw’okutambuza ekibiina ekinene kyonna—galina okugenda mu maaso n’okuba ag’enjawulo, bulijjo, buli wamu, ne mu buli kintu. Tetuyinza kutambuza mirimu gyaffe egy’omwoyo ku ssaala z’omulembe ogwayita. Abantu bangi bakkiriza nti okusaba kukola, naye si bangi abasaba. Okusaba kye kintu ekisinga obwangu era ekisinga obuzibu mu byonna; ekisinga okuba ekyereere era ekisinga obugulumivu; ekisinga obunafu era ekisinga amaanyi; ebiva mu kwo biri wabweru w’ebyo abantu bye basobola—bikomezebwa buyinza bwa Katonda bwokka obutaliiko kkomo.

Abakristaayo batono abalina endowooza ku maanyi g’okusaba etali nfuufu; n’abatono ennyo okusingawo be bamanyi amaanyi ago mu bulamu bwabwe. Ekkanisa erabika ng’etamanyi kumpi n’akatono amaanyi Katonda g’ateeka mu mukono gwayo; carte blanche eno ey’omwoyo ku by’obugagga ebitaggwaawo eby’amagezi n’obuyinza bwa Katonda tekozesebwa okujjako emirundi mitono nnyo, oba tekozesebwa n’akatono—tekozesebwa ku kigero kyakyo kyonna eky’okuwa Katonda ekitiibwa. Kyewuunyisa nga enkozesa bw’eri embi, nga emiganyulo bwe mitono. Okusaba kye kyokulwanyisa kyaffe ekisinga okutiisa, naye kye tusinga obutaba bakugu, era kye tusinga obutayagala kukozesa. Tukolera abantu abatamanyi Katonda buli kintu kirala okuggyako ekintu Katonda ky’ayagala tukole; ekintu kyokka ekiyamba—ekifuula byonna ebirala bye tukola okuba eby’omugaso.

Okutikkirwa mu ssomero ly’okusaba kwe kumanya ddala emisomo gyonna egy’obulamu bw’eddiini. Emitendera egisooka n’egisembayo egy’obulamu obutukuvu gitikkirwa engule y’okusaba. Bukugu bwa bulamu bwonna. Ebiziyiza okusaba bye biziyiza obulamu obutukuvu. Ebisaanyizo by’okusaba bye bisaanyizo by’obutuukirivu, obutukuvu n’obulokozi. Omukozi ow’ekirumbirumbi mu bukugu bw’okusaba aba mukozi ow’ekirumbirumbi mu bukugu bw’obulokozi.

Okusaba bukugu obulina okuyigibwa. Tuteekwa okuba abayizi era tumale ekiseera kyaffe nga tukuyiga. Okufaayo okw’amaanyi, okulowooza okungi, okwegezaamu n’okutegana byetaagisa okusobola okuba omukozi omukugu mu kusaba. Okwegezaamu mu kino, nga bwe kiri mu bukugu obulala bwonna, kwe kuleeta obukugu obujjuvu. Emikono n’emitima egitegana gyokka gye gifuula abantu abakugu mu bukugu buno obw’omu ggulu.

Wadde nga waliwo emiganyulo n’emikisa egiva mu kussa kimu ne Katonda, tuteekwa okukkiriza n’ennaku nti tetusaba nnyo. Omuwendo mutono nnyo, bw’ogeraageranya, gwe gukulembera okusaba mu nkuŋŋaana. Batono n’okusingawo abasaba mu maka gaabwe. Batono n’okusingawo abalina empisa y’okusaba buli kiseera mu bisenge byabwe eby’ekyama. Enkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba zokka tezitera kubaawo ng’omuzira mu Jjuuni. Mu makanisa mangi tewali linnya wadde ekifaananyi ky’olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba. Mu makanisa ag’omu bibuga, olukuŋŋaana olw’okusaba mu linnya si lukuŋŋaana lwa kusaba mu bikolwa. Okubuulira oba okusomesa kye kikulu. Okusaba kya kwongerako bwongezi mu linnya.

Abantu baffe mu butuufu si bantu ba kusaba. Ekyo kirabikira mu bulamu bwabwe.

Okusaba n’obulamu obutukuvu bye kimu. Bikolagana era bikwatagana. Tewali kiyinza kubeerawo kyokka. Bwe wabulawo ekimu, n’ekirala kibulawo. Omumonaaki yayonoona okusaba, n’assa okukkiriza eby’obutaliimu mu kifo ky’okusaba, n’emikolo egitaliimu n’enkola eya bulijjo mu kifo ky’obulamu obutukuvu. Tuli mu kabi ak’okussa emirimu gy’ekkanisa n’enkola etaggwaawo ey’emirimu egy’okweraga mu kifo ky’okusaba n’obulamu obutukuvu. Obulamu obutukuvu tebubeera mu kisenge eky’ekyama, naye tebuyinza kubeerawo awatali kisenge eky’ekyama. Singa, mu ngeri yonna, ekisenge ky’okusaba kiteekebwawo awatali bulamu obutukuvu, kyandibadde kisenge ekitaliimu kubeerawo kwa Katonda.

Okufuula abatukuvu buli wamu okusaba, guno gwe gwali omugugu gw’okufuba kw’abatume era ekisumuluzo ky’obuwanguzi bw’abatume. Yesu Kristo yafuba okukola kino mu nnaku ez’obuweereza bwe ye kennyini. Yakwatibwa ekisa ekitakoma bwe yalaba ennimiro z’ensi ezengedde nga zifa olw’obutaba na bakozi, era n’ayimirizaamu okusaba kwe ye, n’agezaako okuzuukusa emitima egyebase egy’abayigirizwa be eri omulimu gw’okusaba, ng’abalagira nti: “Musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.” Era n’abagerera olugero olw’ensonga eyo, nti abantu bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba.

Abatume baasobola kulaba bulabi obukulu buno obw’okusaba nga Pentekoote tennatuuka. Naye Omwoyo bwe yajja n’ajjuza ku Pentekoote, yasitula okusaba n’akuteeka mu kifo kyakwo ekikulu era ekifuga byonna mu Njiri ya Kristo. Okuyita kw’okusaba kati eri buli mutukuvu kwe kuyita kw’Omwoyo okusinga okuwulikika n’okusinga okwanguyirizibwa. Okutya Katonda okw’abatukuvu kuzimbibwa, kulongoosebwa, kutuukirizibwa, olw’okusaba. Enjiri etambula mpola era n’entiisa ng’abatukuvu tebasaba ku makya, ekiro, era okumala ebbanga eddene.

Bali ludda wa abakulembeze abali nga Kristo abayinza okuyigiriza abatukuvu ab’omulembe guno engeri y’okusaba n’okubateeka ku mulimu ogwo? Abakulembeze baffe bamanyi nti tukuza abatukuvu abatasaba? Bali ludda wa abakulembeze ab’omwoyo ng’ogw’abatume abayinza okufuula abantu ba Katonda okusaba? Ka bajje mu maaso bakole omulimu, era gunaabeera omulimu ogusinga obukulu ogusobola okukolebwa. Okwongera ku bifo eby’okusomeramu n’okwongera ennyo ku maanyi g’ensimbi binaabeera kikolimo eky’amaanyi ennyo eri eddiini singa tebitukuzibwa olw’okusaba okungi era okulungi okusinga kwe tukola kati.

Okusaba okungi tekujja kujja kwokka. Kampeyini ey’ekyasa eky’amakumi abiri oba eky’amakumi asatu tejja kuyamba kusaba kwaffe, wabula ejja kukuziyiza bwe tutaafaayo. Tewali kirala wabula okufuba okw’enjawulo okuva mu bukulembeze obusaba ekiyinza okugasa. Abakulembeze abasaba bokka be bayinza okuba n’abagoberezi abasaba. Abatume abasaba bajja kuzaala abatukuvu abasaba. Ekituuti ekisaba kijja kuzaala entebe ezisaba. Twetaaga nnyo omuntu ayinza okuteeka abatukuvu ku mulimu guno ogw’okusaba. Tuli mulembe gwa batukuvu abatasaba. Abatukuvu abatasaba kibinja kya batukuvu abaavu, abatalina bunyiikivu wadde obulungi, wadde amaanyi g’abatukuvu. Ani alizzaawo ettabi lino? Alibeera asinga obukulu mu baddaabiriza ne mu batume, oyo ayinza okufuula Ekkanisa okusaba.

Abantu abatukuvu, mu biseera eby’edda, bakyusizza embeera z’ensi zonna, bakyusizza empisa z’abantu n’amawanga olw’okusaba. Era ebikolwa ng’ebyo bikyasoboka gye tuli. Amaanyi geetaaga kukozesebwa bukozesebwa. Okusaba kwolesebwa bwolesebwa kw’okukkiriza.

Ekiseera kyandiyinze okuggwaawo okunyumya ebikolwa eby’amaanyi ebikoleddwa okusaba, kubanga olw’okwo abatukuvu “abaawangula bakabaka, be baakola eby’obutuukirivu, be baafuna ebyasuubizibwa, era be baabuniza obumwa bw’empologoma, be baazikiza omuliro ogw’amaanyi, be baawona obwogi bw’ekitala. Be baaweebwa amaanyi okuva mu bunafu, era be baafuuka abazira ab’amaanyi mu ntalo, ne bagoba amaggye g’amawanga, Abakazi baddizibwa abantu baabwe abaali bafudde ne bazuukira

Okusaba kuwa Katonda ekitiibwa; kuswaza omuntu yennyini. Kwe kwegayirira kw’omuntu olw’obunafu, obutamanya, n’obwetaavu. Okwegayirira eggulu kwe litayinza kubuusa maaso. Katonda asanyuka nnyo bwe tusaba.

Okusaba si mulabe wa mirimu, tekulemesa kukola. Kukola n’amaanyi; okusaba kwennyini gwe mulimu ogusinga obukulu. Kuzuukusa okukola, kukubiriza okwegomba n’okufuba. Okusaba si ddagala lya tulo wabula lya maanyi, tekuzibya tulo wabula kuzuukusa buggya olw’okukola. Omugayaavu tasaba, tayagala kusaba, tasobola kusaba, kubanga okusaba kwetaagisa amaanyi. Pawulo akuyita okufuba, okulwana okw’amaanyi. Eri Yakobo kwali kumeggana; eri omukazi Omusulofoyiniiki kwali kulwana okwayita amaanyi gonna agasinga obulungi ag’emmeeme, era okwetaaga amaanyi mangi okukuyitamu.

Ekisenge eky’ekyama si kiddukiro ky’Omukristaayo omugayaavu era atalina mugaso. Si kisenge kya baana bawere bokka. Lye ddwaniro ly’Ekkanisa; kye kigo kyayo; kye kifo eky’entalo ez’obuzira era ezitali za nsi muno. Ekisenge eky’ekyama ye tterekero ly’ebyetaago by’Omukristaayo n’Ekkanisa. Bw’akutulwako, tewasigala kirala wabula okudduka n’okugwa mu kabi. Amaanyi ag’okukola, okwefuga, okununulibwa mu kutya, ebibala byonna eby’omwoyo n’ebirabo byonna eby’omwoyo, byongerwako nnyo okusaba. Enjawulo eri wakati w’amaanyi, obumanyirivu, n’obutukuvu bw’Abakristaayo esangibwa mu njawulo y’okusaba kwabwe.

Essaala entono, ennyimpi, ennafu, bulijjo ziraga embeera ey’omwoyo eya wansi. Abantu basaanidde okusaba ennyo n’okukussaako omwoyo n’amaanyi n’obugumiikiriza. Abakristaayo abakulu baali bakulu mu kusaba. Ebintu eby’omunda ennyo ebya Katonda tebiyigibwa walala wonna. Ebintu ebinene ku lwa Katonda bikolebwa n’essaala ennene. Oyo asaba ennyo, asoma nnyo, ayagala nnyo, akola nnyo, akolera Katonda n’abantu bingi. Okutuukiriza Enjiri, amaanyi g’okukkiriza, okukula n’obulungi bw’ebirabo eby’omwoyo birindirira okusaba.

fields.title: Sabanga era Toggwangamu Mwoyo
fields.body_html:
“Tewali kitasoboka eri obunyiikivu,” bw’atyo bwe yayogera omu ku bagezi omusanvu ab’e Buyonaani. Ka tuggyewo ekigambo obunyiikivu tuteekewo okusaba okutakoowa, olwo ekisoko ekyo kijja kweyongera okuba ekya Kikristaayo era nga kisaanidde okukkirizibwa buli muntu. Nkakasa nti ffenna omwoyo gw’okusaba gutubulako okusinga ekisa ekirala kyonna. Katonda ayagala nnyo okusaba okw’okwetayirira, n’atuuka n’obutatuwa mikisa mingi nga tekuliiwo. Era ensonga lwaki ayagala okusaba okw’engeri eyo eri nti atwagala, era amanyi nti kwe kututeekateeka okwetaagisa okufuna emikisa egisingayo obugagga gy’alindirira era gy’ayaayaanira okutuwa.

Sisabangako kintu kyonna mu mazima ne mu bunyiikivu ne kitajja mu kiseera ekimu—ne bwe kyalwawo okutuuka ennaku nnyingi, mu ngeri emu oba endala, mu kifaananyi kye nnandisembye okulowoozaako, kyajja.—Adoniram Judson

Nkizudde nga kirungi okunyiikiriranga okugezaako okusaba. Bwe mba nga sisobola kusaba na bunyiikivu oba okumala ebbanga eddene nga njogera n’Oyo Katonda, nkizudde nti gye nkoma okusaba mu kyama, gye nkoma okusanyukira okukikola, era nfunye omwoyo gw’okusaba okusingawo; era emirundi mingi nkizudde nti kibeera kikontana bwe ntyo, bwe mba nga olw’okutambula oba olw’ensonga endala, siwezezza kufuna kifo kya kwekusa.—David Brainerd

Kristo akiteeka nti okwetayirira kye kabonero akaawula okusaba okw’amazima. Tetugwanidde kusaba kyokka, wabula tugwanidde okusaba n’obwetaavu obungi, n’omwoyo gwonna era nga tuddiŋŋana. Tetugwanidde kusaba kyokka, wabula tugwanidde okusaba emirundi n’emirundi. Tetugwanidde kukoowa kusaba. Tugwanidde okuba nga tufaayo ddala, nga tweraliikirira nnyo ebintu bye tusaba, kubanga Yesu Kristo yakyoleka kaati nti ekyama ky’okusaba n’obuwanguzi bwakwo biri mu bwetaavu bwakwo obw’amaanyi. Tugwanidde okunyigiriza Katonda n’okusaba kwaffe.

Mu lugero olujjudde okusaasira okw’ekitalo era olwangu okutegeera, Mukama waffe teyayigiriza bwokka nti abantu bagwanidde okusaba, wabula nti bagwanidde okusaba n’omutima gwabwe gwonna, era nti bagwanidde okunyiikiriza ensonga n’amaanyi mangi n’emitima egy’obuvumu.

“Awo Yesu n’agerera abayigirizwa be olugero ng’agamba nga bwe bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo, ng’agamba nti, Waaliwo omulamuzi mu kibuga ekimu, nga tatya Katonda era nga tafa ku muntu yenna. Mu kibuga ekyo mwalimu nnamwandu eyajjanga ew’omulamuzi oyo buli lunaku ng’amwegayirira nti, ‘Nnamula n’omulabe wange.’ Omulamuzi n’amala ebbanga ng’akyagaanyi. Naye oluvannyuma n’agamba mu mutima gwe nti, ‘Newaakubadde nga sitya Katonda era nga sirina muntu gwe nzisaamu kitiibwa, naye olwokubanga nnamwandu ono aneetayiridde nnyo, nzijja kumumalira ensonga ze, kubanga ajja kunkooya olw’okuneetayirira ng’ajja gye ndi buli lunaku!’ Awo Mukama waffe n’agamba nti, Muwulire omulamuzi atali wa mazima bw’agamba. Kale Katonda talisingawo nnyo kulamula abantu be, be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro ate ng’abagumiikiriza? Mbagamba nti agenda kubalamula mangu. Naye Omwana w’Omuntu, bw’alijja, alisanga okukkiriza ku nsi?”

Ensonga y’omukazi ono omwavu yali tekyalina ssuubi, naye okwetayirira kuleeta essuubi okuva mu buziba bw’okuggwaamu essuubi, era kuleeta obuwanguzi awatali buwanguzi wadde obukwakkulizo bwabwo. Tewandibaddewo nsonga esinga eno okulaga engeri okwetayirira okutakoowa era okutatya bwe kutuuka ku kigendererwa kyakwo, ebirala byonna we bigwa. Ebigambo ebisooka mu lugero luno bigamba nti: “Yesu n’agerera abayigirizwa be olugero ng’agamba nga bwe bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo.” Yali amanyi nti abantu bajja kuggwaamu amaanyi mangu mu kusaba, kale okutuzzaamu amaanyi n’atuwa ekifaananyi kino eky’amaanyi ag’ekitalo ag’okwetayirira.

Nnamwandu, omunafu era atalina mubeezi, kye kifaananyi ky’obutaba na bwekwaso; nga talina ssuubi lyonna wadde obuyinza bwonna obwandisobodde okukyusa omulamuzi atali mwenkanya, kyokka awangula ensonga ye olw’okwetayirira kwe okutakoowa era okutawaanya. Obwetaavu bw’okwetayirira, amaanyi gaakwo n’obukulu bwakwo obw’ekitalo mu kusaba, bwandisobodde okulagibwa mu langi ezisingako obuziba oba okukwata ku mutima? Kuyita ku bizibu byonna oba kubiggyawo, kuwangula buli maanyi agakuziyiza, era kutuuka ku kigendererwa kyakwo wakati mu biziyiza ebitasobola kuwangulwa. Tetuyinza kukola kintu kyonna awatali kusaba. Ebintu byonna bisobola okukolebwa olw’okusaba okw’okwetayirira.

Eyo y’enjigiriza ya Yesu Kristo.

Olugero olulala Yesu lwe yagera lukakasa amazima ago gemu amakulu. Omusajja agenda ewa mukwano gwe mu ttumbi okumwazika emigaati. Okwegayirira kwe kwa maanyi, kwesigamiziddwa ku mukwano, ne ku bwetaavu obukwasa ensonyi era obunyigiriza, naye ebyo byonna biremererwa. Tafuna migaati, naye asigala awo ng’anyigiriza, alindirira, era afuna. Okwetayirira kwokka kwe kuwangula ng’okwegayirira n’amaanyi amalala gonna bimaze okuremererwa.

Ensonga y’omukazi Omusulofoyiniiki lugero olwalabikira mu bikolwa. Bw’agezaako okusemberera Kristo, aziyizibwa olw’amawulire nti tayagala kulaba muntu yenna. Agaanibwa okutuuka mu maaso ge, ate bw’atuuka mu maaso ge, ayisibwa ng’atafiibwako, n’obunnyogovu bw’okusirika n’obutafaayo; anyigiriza era asembera, naye okunyigiriza n’okusembera kwe biwakanyizibwa n’ekigambo eky’obukambwe era ekimenya omutima nti teyatumibwa eri bantu ba ggwanga lye, nti ye agobeddwa mu mulimu gwe ne mu buyinza bwe. Atoowazibwa ng’ayitibwa embwa. Kyokka byonna abikkiriza, byonna abiwangula, byonna abifunamu olw’okwetayirira kwe okw’obwetoowaze, okutatya era okutawangulika. Omwana wa Katonda, ng’asanyuse, ng’ewuunyizza, era ng’awanguddwa okwetayirira kwe okutawangulika, amugamba nti: “Mukazi watu, ng’okukkiriza kwo kunene! Kale kikukolerwe nga bw’oyagala.” Yesu Kristo yeewaayo eri okwetayirira kw’okukkiriza okunene. “Kale Katonda talisingawo nnyo kulamula abantu be, be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro ate ng’abagumiikiriza?”

Yesu Kristo ateeka obusobozi bw’okwetayirira ng’ekimu ku bitundu by’okusaba, ekimu ku bukwakkulizo obukulu obw’okusaba. Okusaba kw’omukazi Omusulofoyiniiki kwolesa amaanyi g’okwetayirira agatageraageranyizika, olutalo olwali olw’amazima ennyo, era olwetaagisa amaanyi g’obulamu, obugumiikiriza, n’ebirungi byonna eby’omutindo ogwa waggulu okusinga bwe kyali kirabiddwako mu mpaka za Isthmia oba Olympia.

Amasomo agasooka ag’okwetayirira gayigirizibwa mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi—“Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo.” Gano madaala ag’okweyongerayo mu maaso—“Kubanga buli asaba aweebwa, n’oyo anoonya, azuula, n’oyo akonkona aggulirwawo.”

Awatali kunyiikirira, okusaba kuyinza obutaddibwamu. Okwetayirira kuzimbibwa ku busobozi bw’okunywerera, okunyiikiriza, okulindirira nga tukwatidde ddala obutayabuliza era nga tetusobola kuyabuliza, nga twegomba awatali kuwummula, era nga tugumiikiriza n’emirembe. Okusaba okw’okwetayirira si kintu ekibaawo omulundi gumu, wabula kye kintu ekikulu; si mukolo wabula kwagala kwa maanyi okw’omutima; si kye twetaaga kyokka wabula kye tutayinza kubulwa.

Okusaba mu ngeri yaakwo esingayo obulungi n’obuwanguzi bwakwo obusingayo obukulu kutwala embeera y’omuntu ameggana ne Katonda. Gwe mpaka, kugezesebwa, era buwanguzi bw’okukkiriza; obuwanguzi obutafunibwa ku mulabe, wabula ku Oyo agezesa okukkiriza kwaffe alyoke akugaziye: agezesa amaanyi gaffe atufuule ab’amaanyi okusingawo. Ebintu bitono ebiwa emmeeme amaanyi amapya era ag’olubeerera ng’ekiseera ekiwanvu eky’okusaba okw’okwetayirira okutukooya ennyo. Kifuuka ekintu ky’oyitamu, omulembe, kalenda empya eri omwoyo, obulamu obupya eri eddiini, okutendekebwa ng’okw’abaserikale. Bayibuli tekoowa kukyogera n’okukyolesa nti ebirungi eby’omwoyo ebisingayo bifunibwa ng’empeera y’okufuba okw’omwoyo okusingayo. Mu ddiini ya Bayibuli temuli kuzzibwamu maanyi wadde ekifo eri okwegomba okunafu, okufuba okw’obunafu, n’embeera ez’obugayaavu; byonna birina okuba eby’amaanyi, eby’obwetaavu obw’amaanyi era eby’omuliro. Okwegomba okwaka ng’omuliro, okunyiikiriza okw’omutima gwonna era okutakoowa, bisanyusa eggulu. Katonda ayagala abaana be babeere nga bafaayo ddala awatali kukyuka, era nga bavumu bulijjo mu kufuba kwabwe. Eggulu lirina emirimu mingi nnyo ne liremwa okuwuliriza okusaba okw’omutima ogwekutuddemu, oba okuddamu abakyalira obukyalizi obw’akaseera katono.

Obulamu bwaffe bwonna bulina okuba mu kusaba kwaffe; nga John Knox, tulina okwogera n’okuwulira nti, “Mpa Sikotilandi, oba nfe.” Bye tumanyi ku Katonda ne by’atubikkulira bizaalibwa mu ssaddaaka zaffe ez’omuwendo omunene, mu ntalo zaffe ez’omuwendo omunene, mu kusaba kwaffe okw’omuwendo omunene. Okumeggana n’okusaba okw’ekiro kyonna okwa Yakobo kwaleeta omulembe ogutalyerabirwa mu bulamu bwa Yakobo, kwaleeta Katonda okumuyamba, kwakyusa endowooza n’enneeyisa ya Esawu, kwakyusa embala ya Yakobo, kwawonya era ne kukwata ku bulamu bwe, era ne kuyingira mu mpisa z’eggwanga lyonna.

Ebiseera byaffe eby’okusaba okw’okwetayirira byeyolaba ng’akabonero akasaliddwa ejjinja lya dayimanda mu bifo byaffe ebisingayo obukakanyavu, era biteeka ku mbala zaffe obubonero obutasobola kusangulibwa. Bye biseera ebisinga okweyoleka mu bulamu bwaffe! Ge mayinja ag’ekijjukizo agabeerawo, era ge tukyukira.

Okwetayirira, kiyinza okuddibwamu, bwe bukwakkulizo bw’okusaba. Tulina okunyiikiriza ensonga, si mu kuddiŋŋana okutaliimu, wabula mu kuddiŋŋana okw’obwetaavu. Tuddiŋŋana, si lwa kubala mirundi, wabula olw’okufuna kye tusaba. Tetuyinza kulekera awo kusaba kubanga omutima n’emmeeme biri mu kwo. Tusaba “nga tugumiikirizanga.” Tunywerera ku kusaba kwaffe kubanga mu kwo mwe tuli abalamu. Tunyiikiriza okwegayirira kwaffe kubanga tulina okufuna bye tusaba oba tufe. Kristo atuwa engero bbiri ezisinga okutegeeza okulaga obwetaavu bw’okwetayirira mu kusaba. Oboolyawo Ibulayimu yafiirwa Sodomu olw’obutanyiikiriza okutuuka ku nkomerero ekkubo lye ery’okusaba. Yowaasi, tumanyi, yafiirwa kubanga yalekera awo okukuba.

Obunyiikivu bwa muwendo nnyo eri Katonda nga bwe buli eri abantu. Singa Eriya yalekera awo ku kwegayirira kwe okwasooka, eggulu ligaanye okuwa enkuba yaalyo olw’okusaba kwe okunafu. Singa Yakobo yalekera awo okusaba mu kiseera ky’okwebaka ekisaanidde, yandizibuwaliddwa okuwona okusisinkana Esawu ku lunaku olwaddirira. Singa omukazi Omusulofoyiniiki yaleka okukkiriza kwe ne kuggwaamu amaanyi olw’okusirika, olw’okutoowazibwa, olw’okugobebwa, oba n’alekera awo okulwana kwe wakati mu kkubo, amaka ge agaali gajjudde ennaku tegandiyakiddwako kitangaala olw’okuwonyezebwa kwa muwala we.

Saba era toggwangamu mwoyo—kino kye kisoko Kristo ky’atuwa mu kusaba. Kye kigezo ky’okukkiriza kwaffe, era gye kikoma okuba ekizibu, n’okulindirira gye kukoma okuwanvuwa, ebivaamu gye bikoma okuba eby’ekitiibwa.

Emiganyulo n’obwetaavu bw’okwetayirira biyigirizibwa abatukuvu ab’Endagaano Enkadde. Abantu abasaba balina okuba ab’amaanyi mu ssuubi, ne mu kukkiriza, ne mu kusaba. Balina okumanya okulindirira n’okunyiikiriza, okulindirira Katonda n’okuba nga tufaayo ddala nga tumusemberera.

Ibulayimu yatulekera ekyokulabirako eky’okwegayiririra abalala n’okwetayirira, mu kwegayirira kwe okw’omutima gwonna eri Katonda ku lwa Sodomu ne Ggomola; era, nga bwe kyogeddwako edda, singa teyalekera awo kusaba, oboolyawo ne Katonda teyandirekedde awo kuwa.

“Ibulayimu yalekera awo okusaba nga Katonda tannalekera awo kuwa.” Musa yayigiriza amaanyi g’okwetayirira bwe yeegayiririra Isirayiri okumala ennaku amakumi ana emisana n’ekiro, ng’asiiba era ng’asaba. Era okwetayirira kwe kwamuviiramu obuwanguzi.

Yesu, mu njigiriza ye ne mu kyokulabirako kye, yayolesa era n’atuukiriza enkola eno ey’okwegayirira n’okulindirira ey’Endagaano Enkadde. Nga kyewuunyisa nti Omwana wa Katonda omu yekka, eyajja n’omulimu ogw’obubaka obwava butereevu eri Kitaawe, nga eggulu lye lyokka ku nsi, obulamu bwe bwokka n’etteeka lye lyokka byali kukola by’ayagala Kitaawe mu mulimu ogwo—nga kya kyama nti yali wansi w’etteeka ly’okusaba, nti emikisa egyajja gy’ali gyazaalibwa era ne gigulibwa olw’okusaba; era ekisingako okwewuunyisa nti okwetayirira mu kusaba kye kkubo eryamufunyisa ebintu ebisingayo obugagga okuva eri Katonda. Singa teyasaba na kwetayirira, mu byafaayo bye temwandibaddemu kufuusibwa, era tewandibaddewo bikolwa bya maanyi ebyafuula obuweereza bwe obwa Katonda. Okusaba kwe okw’ekiro kyonna kwe kwajjuzanga omulimu gwe ogw’emisana gyonna okusaasira n’amaanyi. Okusaba okw’okwetayirira okw’obulamu bwe kwe kwatikkira okufa kwe obuwanguzi bwakwo. Yayiga essomo eddene ery’okugondera by’ayagala Katonda mu kulwana kw’okusaba okw’okwetayirira, nga tannayoleka kugonda okwo mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa ekyenkanidde awo ku musaalaba.

“Twagala oba tetwagala,” bw’atyo Omwami Spurgeon bwe yagamba, “okusaba lye tteeka ly’obwakabaka.” “Musabe, mujja kuweebwa.” Lino tteeka eritalikyusibwa ku lwa muntu yenna. Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ye mukulu mu luganda olw’amaka, naye Katonda teyamuwummuzaako tteeka eryo. Jjukira ekyawandiikibwa kino: Yakuwa agamba Omwana we yennyini nti, “Nsaba, nange ndikuwa amawanga gonna okuba obusika bwo, era n’ensi yonna gy’ekoma okuba amatwale go.” Obanga Omwana wa Katonda ow’Obwakabaka era ow’Obwakatonda tayinza kuwummuzibwa ku tteeka lya kusaba alyoke afune, ggwe nange tetuyinza kusuubira tteeka eryo kuwummulwa ku lwaffe. Lwaki kyandibadde bwe kityo? Nsonga ki eyinza okwogerwa lwaki twandiwummuziddwa ku kusaba? Ngeri ki ey’okuwoza eyinza okubaawo lwaki twandiggibwako enkizo n’okusumululwa ku bwetaavu bw’okwegayirira?
